name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by unhygienic
  intros Hup Hinit
  have := InitStatesLength Hinit
  refine ⟨_, rfl,
    updatedStatesInit this
      (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup) $
    InitStatesNodup Hinit, ?_⟩
  induction Hup
  ·
    exact InitStatesUpdated Hinit ▸ UpdateStates.update_none
  ·
    have Hnd := UpdateStateNotDefMonotone'
      (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) a_1) a
    have h1 := UpdateStateDefined' a x List.mem_cons_self
    refine UpdateStates.update_some ?_ $ a_ih Hinit
    simp [UpdateStateUpdated a, updatedStates]
    rewrite [← updatedStateComm']
    apply updatedStateUpdate $ InitStatesSomeMonotone (Option.eq_some_of_isSome h1) $
      updatedStatesInit this Hnd $ InitStatesNodup Hinit
    rewrite [List.unzip_zip this]
    intro
    simp_all [isNotDefined]

name: Lambda.denote_suffix_irrel
proof:
theorem denote_suffix_irrel
    {e : LExpr T.mono} {τ : LMonoTy}
    {Δ₁ : List LMonoTy} {Δ₂ Δ₂' : List LMonoTy}
    (h_lc : LExpr.lcAt Δ₁.length e = true)
    (h₁ : LExpr.HasTypeA (Δ₁ ++ Δ₂) e τ)
    (h₂ : LExpr.HasTypeA (Δ₁ ++ Δ₂') e τ)
    (bv₁ : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ₁)
    (bv₂ : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ₂)
    (bv₂' : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ₂')
    : LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt (HList.append bv₁ bv₂) e τ h₁ =
      LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt (HList.append bv₁ bv₂') e τ h₂ := by unhygienic
  induction e generalizing Δ₁ τ
  rfl
  induction ty
  nomatch LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h₁
  rfl
  simp [denote_bvar, HList.get_append_left _ _ deBruijnIndex _
    ((List.getElem?_append_left $ of_decide_eq_true h_lc) ▸ HasTypeA.bvar_inv h₁)]
  induction ty
  nomatch LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h₁
  rfl
  rcases ty
  nomatch LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h₁
  obtain ⟨_, rfl, h2⟩ := HasTypeA.abs_inv h₁
  rcases HasTypeA.abs_inv h₂
  cases snd.1
  apply (denote_abs _ h2 h₁).trans
    ((funext λx => e_ih h_lc h2 snd.2 $ .cons x bv₁).trans
      (denote_abs _ snd.2 h₂).symm)
  cases ty
  nomatch LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h₁
  obtain ⟨_, rfl, h2⟩ := HasTypeA.quant_inv h₁
  rcases HasTypeA.quant_inv h₂
  apply denote_quant_congr h2.2 snd.2.2 h₁ h₂ λx =>
    e_ih (Δ₁ := val :: Δ₁) ((Bool.and_eq_true ..).mp h_lc).2 h2.2 snd.2.2 $ .cons x bv₁
  have h := HasTypeA.app_inv h₁
  rcases HasTypeA.app_inv h₂
  any_goals simp only [LExpr.lcAt, Bool.and_eq_true] at h_lc
  have := LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck snd.1
  with_reducible rewrite [← typeCheck_of_lcAt_aux h_lc.1
    λi hi => (List.getElem?_append_left hi).symm ▸ List.getElem?_append_left hi,
    LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h.2.1] at this
  cases this
  simp [fn_ih h_lc.1 h.2.1 snd.1, e_ih h_lc.2 h.2.2 snd.2,
    denote_app _ h.2.1 h.2.2, denote_app _ snd.1 snd.2]
  rcases HasTypeA.ite_inv h₁
  rcases HasTypeA.ite_inv h₂
  simp only [denote_ite, left, right, h_lc, left_1, c_ih, right_1, t_ih, e_ih]
  obtain ⟨ty', rfl, h_2₁⟩ := HasTypeA.eq_inv h₁
  rcases HasTypeA.eq_inv h₂
  have := LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck snd.2.1
  with_reducible rewrite [← typeCheck_of_lcAt_aux h_lc.1
    λi hi => (List.getElem?_append_left hi).symm ▸ List.getElem?_append_left hi,
    LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h_2₁.1] at this
  cases this
  have := e1_ih h_lc.1 h_2₁.1 snd.2.1 bv₁
  have q2 := e2_ih h_lc.2 h_2₁.2 snd.2.2 bv₁
  rcases Classical.em _
  apply (denote_eq_true _ h_2₁.1 h_2₁.2 h₁ h).trans
    (denote_eq_true _ snd.2.1 snd.2.2 h₂ $ this.symm.trans $ h.trans q2).symm
  apply (denote_eq_false _ h_2₁.1 h_2₁.2 h₁ h).trans
    (denote_eq_false _ snd.2.1 snd.2.2 h₂ λhh => h $ this.trans $ hh.trans q2.symm).symm

name: Lambda.denote_Denotes
proof:
theorem denote_Denotes
    {T : LExprParams}
    (tcInterp : TyConstrInterp)
    (opInterp : OpInterp tcInterp)
    (fvarVal : FreeVarVal T tcInterp)
    (vt : TyVarVal)
    {Δ : List LMonoTy}
    (bvarVal : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ)
    (e : LExpr T.mono) (τ : LMonoTy)
    (h : LExpr.HasTypeA Δ e τ)
    : Denotes tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt bvarVal e τ h
        (LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt bvarVal e τ h) := by unhygienic
  revert bvarVal
  induction h
  iterate 4 intros; solve_by_elim
  any_goals intro bvarVal <;> unfold LExpr.denote
  rcases HasTypeA.abs_inv _
  rcases snd
  cases left
  exact .abs bvarVal λx => a_ih _
  rcases HasTypeA.quant_inv _
  rcases snd
  rcases right
  cases k
  dsimp
  cases Classical.propDecidable _
  rcases Classical.not_forall.mp h
  exact .quant_all_false bvarVal w $ Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr h_1 ▸ a_ih_1 _
  exact .quant_all_true bvarVal λx => h x ▸ a_ih_1 _
  dsimp
  cases Classical.propDecidable _
  exact .quant_exist_false bvarVal λx =>
    (Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr λhp => h $ .intro x hp) ▸ a_ih_1 _
  obtain ⟨⟩ := h
  exact .quant_exist_true bvarVal w $ h ▸ a_ih_1 _
  rcases HasTypeA.app_inv _
  rcases snd
  obtain rfl := HasTypeA_unique right a_1
  exact .app bvarVal (a_ih bvarVal) $ a_ih_1 bvarVal
  split
  dsimp
  split
  rename_i htrue
  exact .ite_true bvarVal (htrue ▸ a_ih bvarVal) $ a_ih_1 bvarVal
  rename_i hntrue
  exact .ite_false bvarVal
    (Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hntrue ▸ a_ih bvarVal)
    $ a_ih_2 bvarVal
  rcases HasTypeA.eq_inv _
  rcases snd
  rcases right
  obtain rfl := HasTypeA_unique left_1 a
  dsimp
  cases Classical.propDecidable _
  exact .eq_false bvarVal (a_ih bvarVal) (a_ih_1 bvarVal) h
  exact .eq_true bvarVal (a_ih bvarVal) $ h ▸ a_ih_1 bvarVal

name: Lambda.callOfLFunc_eraseMetadata_congr
proof:
theorem callOfLFunc_eraseMetadata_congr
    (F : @Factory Tbase) (e₁ e₂ : LExpr Tbase.mono) (aPA : Bool)
    (h_eM : e₁.eraseMetadata = e₂.eraseMetadata) :
    match F.callOfLFunc e₁ (allowPartialApp := aPA), F.callOfLFunc e₂ (allowPartialApp := aPA) with
    | some (op₁, args₁, f₁), some (op₂, args₂, f₂) =>
        f₁ = f₂ ∧ args₁.map LExpr.eraseMetadata = args₂.map LExpr.eraseMetadata
        ∧ op₁.eraseMetadata = op₂.eraseMetadata
    | none, none => True
    | _, _ => False := by unhygienic
  have := getLFuncCall_eraseMetadata_congr e₁ e₂ h_eM
  unfold Factory.callOfLFunc
  rcases h_glfc₁ : getLFuncCall e₁
  rcases h_glfc₂ : getLFuncCall e₂
  simp [*] at this
  induction EMEquiv.of_eraseMetadata_eq _ _ this.1 <;> dsimp
  rcases F[n.1]?
  dsimp
  grind -funext only [List.length_map]

name: Lambda.liftBVars_typeCheck
proof:
theorem liftBVars_typeCheck
    (e : LExpr T.mono)
    {Δ₁ Δ_insert Δ_outer : List LMonoTy}
    : LExpr.typeCheck (Δ₁ ++ Δ_insert ++ Δ_outer) (LExpr.liftBVars Δ_insert.length e Δ₁.length)
      = LExpr.typeCheck (Δ₁ ++ Δ_outer) e := by
  fun_induction LExpr.typeCheck Δ₁ e
  all_goals simp_all -contextual [LExpr.liftBVars, LExpr.typeCheck]
  grind only [LExpr.typeCheck, List.getElem?_append]

name: Lambda.liftBVars_denote
proof:
theorem liftBVars_denote
    {e : LExpr T.mono} {τ : LMonoTy}
    {Δ₁ Δ_insert Δ_outer : List LMonoTy}
    (h_orig : LExpr.HasTypeA (Δ₁ ++ Δ_outer) e τ)
    (h_lifted : LExpr.HasTypeA (Δ₁ ++ (Δ_insert ++ Δ_outer)) (LExpr.liftBVars Δ_insert.length e Δ₁.length) τ)
    (bv₁ : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ₁)
    (bv_insert : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ_insert)
    (bv_outer : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ_outer)
    : LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt (HList.append bv₁ (HList.append bv_insert bv_outer))
        (LExpr.liftBVars Δ_insert.length e Δ₁.length) τ h_lifted =
      LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt (HList.append bv₁ bv_outer) e τ h_orig := by unhygienic
  induction e generalizing Δ₁ bv₁ τ
  rfl
  induction ty <;> rfl
  by_cases h_ge : deBruijnIndex ≥ Δ₁.length
  simp [LExpr.liftBVars, ↓if_pos h_ge]
  have hE : deBruijnIndex + Δ_insert.length - Δ₁.length - Δ_insert.length = deBruijnIndex - Δ₁.length :=
    by rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_sub_assoc h_ge, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hD :=
    (List.getElem?_append_right h_ge).symm.trans $ HasTypeA.bvar_inv h_orig
  rewrite [denote_bvar, denote_bvar,
      bv₁.get_append_right _ _ _
        ((List.getElem?_append_right $ by omega).trans $ by rewrite [hE]; assumption)
        (Nat.le_trans h_ge $ Nat.le_add_right ..),
      bv_insert.get_append_right bv_outer _ _ (by rewrite [hE]; assumption) $ by omega,
      bv₁.get_append_right bv_outer deBruijnIndex _ hD h_ge]
  congr 1
  simp [LExpr.liftBVars, ↓if_neg h_ge]
  rewrite [denote_bvar, denote_bvar,
      HList.get_append_left,
      bv₁.get_append_left bv_outer deBruijnIndex _ $
        (List.getElem?_append_left $ Nat.lt_of_not_le h_ge).symm.trans $ HasTypeA.bvar_inv h_orig]
  exact rfl
  induction ty <;> rfl
  induction ty
  rfl
  any_goals dsimp [LExpr.liftBVars] at ⊢
  let ⟨rty_l, h_eq_l, h_body_l⟩ := HasTypeA.abs_inv h_lifted
  let ⟨rty_o, h_eq_o, h_body_o⟩ := HasTypeA.abs_inv h_orig
  subst h_eq_l
  cases h_eq_o
  rewrite [denote_abs _ h_body_l, denote_abs _ h_body_o]
  funext x
  apply e_ih h_body_o h_body_l $ .cons x bv₁
  induction ty
  rfl
  let ⟨_, _, _, h_body_l⟩ := HasTypeA.quant_inv h_lifted
  let ⟨_, h_τ_o, _, h_body_o⟩ := HasTypeA.quant_inv h_orig
  subst h_τ_o
  apply denote_quant_congr h_body_l h_body_o h_lifted h_orig
    λx => e_ih h_body_o h_body_l $ .cons x bv₁
  let ⟨aty_l, h_fn_l, h_arg_l⟩ := HasTypeA.app_inv h_lifted
  let ⟨aty_o, h_fn_o, h_arg_o⟩ := HasTypeA.app_inv h_orig
  have h1 := LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h_fn_l
  rewrite [←List.append_assoc, liftBVars_typeCheck, LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h_fn_o] at h1
  cases h1
  simp [denote_app _ h_fn_l h_arg_l, denote_app _ h_fn_o h_arg_o,
      fn_ih h_fn_o, e_ih h_arg_o]
  let ⟨h_c_l, h_t_l, h_e_l⟩ := HasTypeA.ite_inv h_lifted
  let ⟨h_c_o, h_t_o, h_e_o⟩ := HasTypeA.ite_inv h_orig
  rewrite [denote_ite _ h_c_l h_t_l h_e_l,
      denote_ite,
      c_ih h_c_o, t_ih h_t_o, e_ih h_e_o]
  exact rfl
  let ⟨ty_l, _, h_1_l, h_2_l⟩ := HasTypeA.eq_inv h_lifted
  let ⟨ty_o, h_τ_o, h_1_o, h_2_o⟩ := HasTypeA.eq_inv h_orig
  subst h_τ_o
  have := LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h_1_l
  rewrite [←List.append_assoc, liftBVars_typeCheck, LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h_1_o] at this
  cases this
  rcases Classical.em _
  rw [denote_eq_true _ h_1_o h_2_o h_orig h,
      denote_eq_true _ h_1_l h_2_l h_lifted
 $ by rewrite [e1_ih, e2_ih]; assumption]
  simp [denote_eq_false _ h_1_o h_2_o h_orig h,
      denote_eq_false _ h_1_l h_2_l h_lifted
 $ by rewrite [e1_ih, e2_ih]; assumption]

name: Lambda.LExpr.typeCheck_to_HasTypeA
proof:
theorem LExpr.typeCheck_to_HasTypeA {T : LExprParams} {Δ : List LMonoTy}
    {e : LExpr T.mono} {τ : LMonoTy}
    (h : typeCheck Δ e = some τ) : HasTypeA Δ e τ := by with_reducible
  fun_induction typeCheck Δ e generalizing τ
  any_goals first | injection h | simp +zetaDelta only [bind, guard, beq_iff_eq, ↓Option.bind_eq_some_iff, Option.pure_def, ↓ite_eq_left_iff, reduceCtorEq, imp_false, Decidable.not_not] at h
  any_goals repeat obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
  any_goals have := LMonoTy.isArrow_some $ by assumption
  any_goals subst_vars
  all_goals constructor <;> apply_rules

name: Lambda.callOfLFunc_constr_disjoint_denote
proof:
theorem callOfLFunc_constr_disjoint_denote
    {T : LExprParams} [DecidableEq T.IDMeta] [Inhabited T.mono.base.IDMeta]
    (tcInterp : TyConstrInterp) (opInterp : OpInterp tcInterp)
    (fvarVal : FreeVarVal T tcInterp) (vt : TyVarVal)
    {F : @Factory T} {tf : @TypeFactory T.IDMeta}
    {e₁ e₂ : LExpr T.mono} {τ : LMonoTy}
    {callee₁ callee₂ : LExpr T.mono}
    {args₁ args₂ : List (LExpr T.mono)}
    {f₁ f₂ : LFunc T.mono.base}
    (h₁ : LExpr.HasTypeA [] e₁ τ)
    (h₂ : LExpr.HasTypeA [] e₂ τ)
    (hcall₁ : Factory.callOfLFunc F e₁ = some (callee₁, args₁, f₁))
    (hcall₂ : Factory.callOfLFunc F e₂ = some (callee₂, args₂, f₂))
    (hconstr₁ : f₁.isConstr = true) (hconstr₂ : f₂.isConstr = true)
    (hdiffname : f₁.name.name ≠ f₂.name.name)
    (hoc₁ : OpsConsistent F e₁) (hoc₂ : OpsConsistent F e₂)
    (hfwf : FactoryWF F) (hcwf : Factory.ConstrWellFormed F tf)
    (htfwf : TypeFactoryWF tf)
    (hConstrIC : ConstrInterpConsistent tcInterp opInterp F)
    : LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt .nil e₁ τ h₁ ≠
      LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt .nil e₂ τ h₂ := by unhygienic
  obtain ⟨argTys₁, ty_op₁, m₁, name₁, h_args₁, hty_op₁, hcallee₁, hdenote₁⟩ :=
    callOfLFunc_denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt hcall₁ h₁
  obtain ⟨argTys₂, ty_op₂, m₂, name₂, h_args₂, hty_op₂, hcallee₂, hdenote₂⟩ :=
    callOfLFunc_denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt hcall₂ h₂
  obtain ⟨tySubst₁, -, htySubst₁⟩ := OpsConsistent_callOfLFunc hoc₁ hcall₁
  have := htySubst₁ _ _ _ hcallee₁
  rewrite [hty_op₁, subst_mkArrow'] at this
  rcases LMonoTy.mkArrow'_injective (by
              simp [h_args₁.length_eq.symm.trans $ Factory.callOfLFunc_arity hcall₁]) this
  obtain ⟨tySubst₂, -, htySubst₂⟩ := OpsConsistent_callOfLFunc hoc₂ hcall₂
  have := htySubst₂ _ _ _ hcallee₂
  rewrite [hty_op₂, subst_mkArrow'] at this
  rcases LMonoTy.mkArrow'_injective (by
              simp [h_args₂.length_eq.symm.trans $ Factory.callOfLFunc_arity hcall₂]) this
  rcases show ∃ vt', ∀ ty,
              LMonoTy.substTyVars vt (LMonoTy.subst tySubst₁ ty) = _ from .intro _ $ substTyVars_subst vt tySubst₁
  have : argTys₁.map (LMonoTy.substTyVars vt) =
      f₁.inputs.values.map (LMonoTy.substTyVars w) := by
    rewrite [ListMap.values_eq_map_snd, right, List.map_map]
    apply List.map_congr_left λty _ => h ty
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hcallee₁', hget₁⟩ := Factory.callOfLFunc_getElem? hcall₁
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hcallee₂', hget₂⟩ := Factory.callOfLFunc_getElem? hcall₂
  subst hcallee₁
  cases hcallee₁'
  subst hcallee₂
  cases hcallee₂'
  rewrite [hdenote₁, hdenote₂, ← Factory.getElem?_name hget₁, ← Factory.getElem?_name hget₂]
  have := Factory.getElem?_is_some_implies_mem hget₁
  have hmem₂ := Factory.getElem?_is_some_implies_mem hget₂
  obtain ⟨d₁, hd₁_mem, c₁, hf₁_eq⟩ := hcwf f₁ this hconstr₁
  obtain ⟨d₂, hd₂_mem, c₂, hf₂_eq⟩ := hcwf f₂ hmem₂ hconstr₂
  have ho₁ : f₁.output = dataDefault d₁ := hf₁_eq.2 ▸ rfl
  have ho₂ : f₂.output = dataDefault d₂ := hf₂_eq.2 ▸ rfl
  obtain rfl := htfwf.eq_of_name_eq hd₁_mem hd₂_mem (LMonoTy.tcons.inj $ show τ = .tcons d₁.1 (LMonoTys.subst tySubst₁ $ d₁.typeArgs.map .ftvar) by
    rewrite [left, ho₁]
    delta dataDefault data
    simp [LMonoTy.subst_tcons].symm.trans $ by
    rewrite [left_1, ho₂]
    delta dataDefault data
    rw [LMonoTy.subst_tcons]).1
  have := hConstrIC.constr_disjoint f₁ f₂ this hmem₂ hconstr₁ hconstr₂ hdiffname w
  have : argTys₂.map (LMonoTy.substTyVars vt) =
      f₂.inputs.values.map (LMonoTy.substTyVars w) := by
    rewrite [ListMap.values_eq_map_snd, right_1, ← constr_same_output_implies_same_argTys (hfwf.lfuncs_wf f₂ hmem₂) (
      ((congrArg _ $ ho₁.trans ho₂.symm).symm.trans left.symm).trans left_1) $ constrFunc_output_covers_typeArgs hcwf hmem₂ hconstr₂, List.map_map]
    apply List.map_congr_left λty _ => h ty
  clear hdenote₁ hdenote₂ hcall₁ hcall₂ hget₁ hget₂ htySubst₁ htySubst₂
  grind only

name: Lambda.denote_replaceMetadata
proof:
theorem denote_replaceMetadata
    {T : LExprParams} [Inhabited T.mono.base.IDMeta]
    (tcInterp : TyConstrInterp)
    (opInterp : OpInterp tcInterp)
    (fvarVal : FreeVarVal T tcInterp)
    (vt : TyVarVal)
    {Δ : List LMonoTy}
    (bvarVal : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ)
    {e₁ : LExpr T.mono} {τ : LMonoTy} (f : T.Metadata → NewMetadata)
    (h₁ : LExpr.HasTypeA Δ e₁ τ):
    let T' : LExprParams := ⟨NewMetadata, T.IDMeta⟩
    let opInterp' : OpInterp tcInterp := opInterp
    let fvarVal' : FreeVarVal T' tcInterp := fvarVal
    LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt bvarVal e₁ τ h₁ =
    LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp' fvarVal' vt bvarVal (LExpr.replaceMetadata e₁ f) τ (replaceMetadata_HasTypeA f h₁) := by unhygienic
    induction h₁
    iterate 4 rfl
    simp [LExpr.replaceMetadata, denote_abs bvarVal a,
      denote_abs bvarVal $ replaceMetadata_HasTypeA f a, a_ih]
    induction k <;> rcases Classical.em _
    apply (denote_quant_all_true _ _ _ h).trans
      (denote_quant_all_true _ _ _
        λx => a_ih_1 _ ▸ h x).symm
    have := Classical.not_forall.1 h
    apply (denote_quant_all_false _ _ _ this.choose $ Bool.eq_false_iff.2 this.choose_spec).trans
      (denote_quant_all_false _ _ _ this.choose
        (a_ih_1 _ ▸ Bool.eq_false_iff.2 this.choose_spec)).symm
    apply Exists.elim h λw hw =>
      (denote_quant_exist_true _ _ _ w hw).trans
        (denote_quant_exist_true _ _ _ w $ a_ih_1 _ ▸ hw).symm
    have := not_exists.1 h
    apply (denote_quant_exist_false _ _ _ λx => Bool.eq_false_iff.2 $ this x).trans
      (denote_quant_exist_false _ _ _
        λx => a_ih_1 _ ▸ Bool.eq_false_iff.2 (this x)).symm
    simp [LExpr.replaceMetadata, denote_app bvarVal a a_1,
      denote_app bvarVal (replaceMetadata_HasTypeA f a) $ replaceMetadata_HasTypeA f a_1,
      a_ih, a_ih_1]
    simp only [LExpr.replaceMetadata, denote_ite bvarVal a a_1 a_2,
      denote_ite bvarVal (replaceMetadata_HasTypeA f a) (replaceMetadata_HasTypeA f a_1)
        (replaceMetadata_HasTypeA f a_2),
      a_ih, a_ih_1, a_ih_2]
    rcases Classical.em _
    apply (denote_eq_true _ _ _ _ h).trans
      (denote_eq_true _ _ _ _

proof:
lemma cauchyBinet {m : ℕ} {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [LinearOrder n]
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) n R) (B : Matrix n (Fin m) R) :
    (A * B).det = ∑ S : {S : Finset n // S.card = m},
      (A.submatrix id (S.1.orderEmbOfFin S.2)).det *
      (B.submatrix (S.1.orderEmbOfFin S.2) id).det := by unhygienic

      ∑ τ : Equiv.Perm $ Fin m, τ.sign * ∏ i, M i _ :=
    λM => Matrix.det_transpose M ▸ Matrix.det_apply' Mᵀ

    simp only [show ∑ σ, (if Function.Injective σ ∧ Finset.image σ Finset.univ = S.val then f σ else 0) = ∑ τ : Equiv.Perm _, (∏ i, A i (S.val.orderEmbOfFin S.property _)) * Matrix.det ((B.submatrix _ id).submatrix τ id) by
      rewrite [← Finset.sum_filter, show Finset.filter (λσ => Function.Injective σ ∧ Finset.image σ Finset.univ = S.val) Finset.univ = Finset.image (λτ : Equiv.Perm _ => S.val.orderEmbOfFin S.property ∘ τ) Finset.univ by
        ext
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_image, true_and]
        constructor
        intros
        have : Function.Injective
            λi => (S.val.orderIsoOfFin S.property).symm ⟨_, a_1.2 ▸ Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ $ Finset.mem_univ i⟩ :=
          λi j hij => a_1.1 $ congrArg Subtype.val $ (S.val.orderIsoOfFin S.property).symm.injective hij
        refine ⟨Equiv.ofBijective _ this.bijective_of_finite, funext λi => ?_⟩
        simp [← Finset.coe_orderIsoOfFin_apply]
        rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
        constructor
        exact (S.val.orderEmbOfFin S.property).injective.comp a.injective
        apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le $ Finset.image_subset_iff.mpr λi _ => Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem ..
        rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ λi j hij => by simpa using hij, S.2]
        simp, Finset.sum_image λτ _ τ' _ h => Equiv.Perm.ext λi => by simpa using congr_fun h i]
      rfl, Matrix.det_permute, this $ A.submatrix id _, Finset.sum_mul,
      Matrix.submatrix_apply, id_eq]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl λτ _ => by rw [mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
  simp only [show Matrix.det (A * B) = ∑ σ, f σ by
    simp only [this, Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.prod_sum, prod_mul_distrib, mul_sum, f]
    rewrite [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl λσ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl λτ _ => mul_left_comm .., show ∑ σ, f σ = ∑ S : {S : Finset n // S.card = m}, ∑ σ, if Function.Injective σ ∧ Finset.image σ Finset.univ = S.val then f σ else 0 by
    rewrite [← Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl λσ _ => ?_
    by_cases hσ : Function.Injective σ
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem ⟨Finset.image σ Finset.univ, by rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hσ, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]⟩ (Finset.mem_univ _) λb _ hb => if_neg λh => hb $ Subtype.ext h.2.symm, if_pos $ .intro hσ rfl]

    rcases h

    rcases fresh_exists $ t₁_1.fvTm ∪ h.2.choose_spec.choose

    assumption

 $ by simp_rw [h.choose_spec.2, List.getElem_take]; exact (h_yls_e j).choose_spec.1

proof:
theorem nonUniform_step [Fintype P] (hpc1 : a.PseudoConsensus 1)
    {s : State P M S} (hr : a.Reachable inp s) (hn : a.NonUniform s) (p : P) :
    ∃ s', a.lts.CanReach s s' ∧ ∀ b, a.CanDecideWithout s' p b := by

  obtain ⟨_, s', ⟨xs, h_mtr⟩, h_s'⟩ := hn !b
  unhygienic rcases LTS.Execution.of_mTr h_mtr.1
  have ⟨h_len, h_start, h_last, h_trans⟩ := h
  have reach_lemma {k} h' : a.lts.CanReach s w[k] :=
    .intro _ $ (h.split k ?_).1.to_mTr

    ⟨_, by omega, _, CanReachVia.refl .., h_last ▸ h_s'⟩

  unhygienic rcases Nat.find_spec h_nb
  have hP k : ∀ h', k ≤ n → a.CanDecideWithout (GetElem.getElem w k h') p b := by
    induction k
    intros
    exact h_start ▸ h_s
    rename_i k h_ind
    unhygienic intros
    have hkl := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt h'
    have hkP := h_ind hkl $ Nat.le_of_succ_le a_1
    have : k < xs.length := by omega
    have h_tr := @h_trans k this
    generalize xs[k] = v at h_tr
    rcases v
    exact Algorithm.tr_none h_tr ▸ hkP
    exact canDecideWithout_uniform hpc1
      (Algorithm.reachable_stable hr $ reach_lemma hkl) h_tr hkP
      (Nat.find_min h_nb a_1 ⟨hkl, ·⟩)
  use w[n], reach_lemma w_1
  intro b'
  cases b' <;> rcases b <;> first | exact hP n w_1 $ Nat.le_refl .. | assumption
  omega

theorem OmegaExecution.flatten_execution [Inhabited Label]
    {ts : ωSequence State} {μls : ωSequence (List Label)} {sls : ωSequence (List State)}
    (hexec : ∀ k, lts.Execution (ts k) (μls k) (ts (k + 1)) (sls k))
    (hpos : ∀ k, (μls k).length > 0) :
    ∃ ss, lts.OmegaExecution ss μls.flatten ∧

  split_ands
  intro n
  simp_rw [flatten_def, this]
  have := segment_lower_bound h_mono rfl n
  have := segment_upper_bound h_mono rfl n

  have := cumLen_succ segs j

  by_cases h_n : n + 1 < segs.cumLen H
  have : n + 1 - segs.cumLen j < (segs j).length := by omega
  rewrite [segment_range_val h_mono (by omega) h_n]
  clear hL
  grind
  have : n + 1 - segs.cumLen j = (segs j).length := by omega
  rewrite [show n + 1 = segs.cumLen H by omega, segment_idem h_mono]
  grind
  simp [this, extract_flatten h_pos, segs]

      ?_ _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i ?_ $ fiberMap k)).symm
  set f_i_plus_1 := fold 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ (by omega)
    _ r_chal
  have h2 : f_i_plus_1 y = (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val +
      r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val := by
    have : f_i_plus_1 y = P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ +
        P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ := rfl
    simp only [this, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, h_eval_qMap, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P_i]
    rewrite [show (fiberMap 1).val = (fiberMap 0).val + 1 by
      have : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = 0 := rfl
      have hF1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = 1 := rfl
      simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y, hF1, one_smul, AddMemClass.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, this, zero_smul, zero_add, fiberMap]
      ring]
    ring
  simp -dsimp only [h2, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul, ←Polynomial.eval_add, mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_mul, Polynomial.C_add, add_mul, ←mul_assoc]
  with_reducible_and_instances rfl
  all_goals omega

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i.castSucc

  have : 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) ≤ BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 i.castSucc - 1 := by
    rewrite [←mul_assoc]
    refine (mul_le_mul_right'
      (Nat.le_of_lt_succ $ WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt) _).trans ?_
    dsimp [BBF_CodeDistance]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add,
      Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev _ _ _ (Nat.le_add_left ..)
        (Nat.le_trans h_i_add_steps $ Nat.le_add_right ..),
      Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev _ _ _ (Nat.le_add_left ..) h_i_add_steps,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel]

  unhygienic rcases show ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw
              = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard by
              unhygienic rcases Nat.sInf_mem
                          (Set.Nonempty.image _ ⟨(⟨0, Submodule.zero_mem _⟩ : C_i), Set.mem_univ _⟩)
              with_reducible exact ⟨w.val, w.property, Eq.symm h.2⟩

  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (le_trans
    (distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f w h.1)
    (ENat.coe_le_coe.2 $ by
      rewrite [h.2]
      let Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f w
      haveI := Fintype.ofFinite Y_bad
      refine (Finset.card_le_card (?_ : Finset.filter _ Finset.univ ⊆ Y_bad.toFinset.biUnion λy => (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ steps (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) y '' Set.univ).toFinset)).trans ?_
      intro x hx_in_ΔH
      let y_of_x := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨y_of_x, Set.mem_toFinset.2
        ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx_in_ΔH).2⟩,
        Set.mem_toFinset.2 $ (Set.mem_image ..).2 ⟨_,
          Set.mem_univ _, is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
            x y_of_x |>.mp rfl⟩⟩
      refine Finset.card_biUnion_le.trans ?_
      simp only [Set.toFinset_card, card_qMap_total_fiber, sum_const, smul_eq_mul, h_i_add_steps]
      rw [←Nat.card_coe_set_eq, card_eq_fintype_card])) 2)
    (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le this)

name: Combine.master_lemma
proof:
lemma master_lemma
  [Nonempty ι]
  {φ : ι ↪ F} {dstar m : ℕ}
  {fs : Fin m → ι → F} {degs : Fin m → ℕ} (hdegs : ∀ i, degs i ≤ dstar)
  {δ : ℝ≥0}
  (hδLt : δ < (min (1 - (ReedSolomon.sqrtRate dstar φ))
    (1 - (rate (code φ dstar)) - 1 / Fintype.card ι)))
  {S : Finset ι}
  (hS_card : (1 - δ) * (Fintype.card ι) ≤ S.card)
  {v : (i : Fin m) → Fin (block_size dstar degs i) → Polynomial F}
  (hv_deg : ∀ i j, (v i j).degree < dstar)
  (hv_eval : ∀ i j, ∀ x ∈ S, (v i j).eval (φ x) = (φ x) ^ j.val * (fs i x))
  (i : Fin m)
  (j : Fin (block_size dstar degs i)) :
  (v i j).degree < degs i + j := by unhygienic
  have hlt : dstar < Fintype.card ι := by
    by_contra contra
    simp [ReedSolomon.rateOfLinearCode_eq_min_div,
      min_eq_right $ not_lt.mp contra] at hδLt
  rcases j
  dsimp [block_size] at isLt
  generalize hj': dstar - degs i - val = j'
  revert val
  induction j'
  intro val
  intros
  obtain rfl : val = dstar - degs i := by omega
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le $ hv_deg i _
  erw [←Nat.cast_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le $ hdegs i]
  intros
  have this := Nat.succ_lt_succ $ Nat.lt_of_sub_eq_succ hj'
  specialize a _ this $ by omega
  simp only [←
    Polynomial.eq_of_eval_eq_degree (p := .X * v i ⟨val, isLt⟩) (q := v i $ .mk _ this)
      (by
        simp
        exact ((WithBot.add_lt_add_iff_left WithBot.coe_ne_bot).2 $ hv_deg i _).trans_eq $ add_comm ..) (lt_trans (hv_deg ..)
        (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr dstar.lt_succ_self))
      _ (by
        rewrite [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ φ.injective]
        exact_mod_cast (even_more_glorious_lemma
          Fintype.card_pos $ by
            simpa [ReedSolomon.rateOfLinearCode_eq_min_div, min_eq_left hlt.le] using
              glorious_lemma hδLt rfl).le.trans hS_card)
      λy hy ↦ by
        obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, pow_succ', mul_assoc,
          hv_eval i _ x hx], Polynomial.degree_mul, Polynomial.degree_X] at a
  rewrite [add_comm] at a
  exact (WithBot.add_lt_add_iff_right WithBot.coe_ne_bot).mp a

name: JohnsonBound.johnson_bound_alphabet_free
proof:
theorem johnson_bound_alphabet_free [Field F]
    {B : Finset (Fin n → F)} {v : Fin n → F} {e : ℕ} (hB : 1 < B.card) :
    let d := sInf { d | ∃ u ∈ B, ∃ v ∈ B, u ≠ v ∧ hammingDist u v = d }
    let q : ℚ := card F
    let _frac := q / (q - 1)
    e ≤ n - ((n * (n - d)) : ℝ).sqrt →
    (B ∩ ({ x | Δ₀(x, v) ≤ e } : Finset _)).card ≤ q * d * n := by
  intro d q frac h
  let B' := B ∩ ({ x | Δ₀(x, v) ≤ e } : Finset _)
  have q_not_small : q ≥ 2 :=
    Nat.cast_le.2 $ Nat.succ_le_of_lt $ Fintype.one_lt_card_iff.mpr ⟨_, _, zero_ne_one⟩
  have d_not_small : d ≥ 1 := by
    unhygienic
      rcases one_lt_card.mp hB
      rcases h_1.2
    exact le_csInf ⟨_, w, h_1.1, w_1, h_2.1, h_2.2, rfl⟩
      λs ⟨x, _, y, hdist⟩ => hdist.2.2 ▸ Nat.succ_le_of_lt (hammingDist_pos.mpr hdist.2.1)
  have n_not_small : n ≥ 1 := by
    by_contra hn
    have : n = 0 := by omega
    subst this
    exact absurd hB $ not_lt.2 $ card_le_one.2 λ_ _ _ _ => funext (Fin.elim0 ·)
  have hq_gt1 := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℚ) < 2) q_not_small
  have hq_pos := zero_lt_two.trans_le q_not_small
  by_cases h_size : B'.card < 2
  exact le_trans (mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt_succ h_size)
    (le_trans (by norm_num : (1 : ℚ) ≤ 2)
      (johnson_qdn_ge_two q_not_small d_not_small n_not_small))
  have hd_le_dB' : d ≤ JohnsonBound.d B' := by
    unhygienic
      rcases one_lt_card.mp $ show 1 < B'.card by omega
      rcases h_1.2
    apply le_trans $ Nat.cast_le.2 $ Nat.sInf_le ?_
    exact_mod_cast min_dist_le_d $ by omega
    unhygienic
      rcases Nat.sInf_mem $ show ({d | ∃ x ∈ B', ∃ y ∈ B', x ≠ y ∧ hammingDist x y = d} : Set ℕ).Nonempty
        from ⟨_, w, h_1.1, w_1, h_2.1, h_2.2, rfl⟩
      rcases h_3.2
    exact ⟨w_2, (mem_inter.mp h_3.1).1, w_3, (mem_inter.mp h_4.1).1, h_4.2⟩
  have hn_pos_nat := Nat.succ_le_iff.1 n_not_small
  have hn_pos : (0 : ℚ) < n := Nat.cast_pos.2 hn_pos_nat
  have hq1_pos := sub_pos.mpr hq_gt1
  rcases Classical.em _ with h_d_close_n | h_d_close_n
  have H2 := div_nonneg hq_pos.le $ sub_nonneg.mpr hq_gt1.le
  calc B'.card
      ≤ frac * JohnsonBound.d B' / n / JohnsonDenominator B' v :=
        johnson_bound $ by
          simp only [JohnsonConditionStrong, mul_div_assoc]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le
            (lt_of_le_of_lt (sub_le_sub le_rfl
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hd_le_dB'
                (mod_cast n.cast_nonneg))
                H2))
              (sub_lt_zero.2 h_d_close_n))
            (sq_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ _ :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left
          (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg H2
            (le_trans (mod_cast d.zero_le) hd_le_dB')) hn_pos.le)
          (one_div_pos.mpr $ mul_pos hn_pos hq1_pos) $ by
            refine (johnson_gap_frac_d_gt_one q_not_small n_not_small h_d_close_n
              hd_le_dB').trans ?_
            simp only [JohnsonDenominator, mul_div_assoc]
            exact johnson_den_ge_frac_d
  rw [one_div, div_inv_eq_mul, mul_comm (n:ℚ), ← mul_assoc,
    div_mul_eq_mul_div,
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ hn_pos.ne',
    mul_assoc, mul_comm _ $ q - 1, ← mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ q hq1_pos.ne']
  exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (johnson_d_le_n $ le_of_not_gt h_size) hq_pos.le)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (le_mul_of_one_le_right hq_pos.le $ mod_cast d_not_small) hn_pos.le)
  have d_le_n : d ≤ n := by
    unhygienic
      rcases one_lt_card.mp hB
      rcases h_1.2
    exact le_trans (Nat.sInf_le ⟨w, h_1.1, w_1, h_2.1, h_2.2, rfl⟩)
      ((hammingDist_le_card_fintype).trans (Fintype.card_fin n).le)
  have hfrac_gt1 :=
    (one_lt_div hq1_pos).2 $ sub_lt_self q one_pos
  have : JohnsonConditionStrong B' v := by
    have h_muln : e / n ≤ 1 - (1 - d / n : ℝ).sqrt := by
      let H1 : ℝ := n * (n - d)
      calc e / n
          ≤ (n - H1.sqrt) / n :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h n.cast_nonneg
        _ = 1 - H1.sqrt / n := by rw [sub_div, div_self $ Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hn_pos_nat.ne']
      rw [show 1 - (d : ℝ) / n = n * (n - d) / n ^ 2 by
        field_simp,
        Real.sqrt_div' _ $ sq_nonneg _, Real.sqrt_sq n.cast_nonneg]
    have h_J_bound : 1 - (1 - d / n : ℝ).sqrt ≤ J q (d / n) := by
      simpa using sqrt_le_J hq_gt1 (by positivity)
        (div_le_one_of_le₀ (mod_cast d_le_n) $ by positivity)
        (le_of_not_gt h_d_close_n)
    exact johnson_condition_weak_implies_strong
      (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_trans h_muln h_J_bound) $ johnson_e_div_ne_J hn_pos_nat
        (Nat.succ_le_iff.1 d_not_small) hq_gt1 h_muln h_J_bound
        (le_of_not_gt h_d_close_n))
      (show 1 < B'.card by omega)
      (mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt $ Fintype.one_lt_card_iff.mpr ⟨_, _, zero_ne_one⟩)
  let H := JohnsonBound.d B' / n - 2 * JohnsonBound.e B' v / n + frac * (JohnsonBound.e B' v / n) ^ 2
  calc B'.card
      ≤ frac * JohnsonBound.d B' / n / JohnsonDenominator B' v :=
        johnson_bound this
    _ ≤ _ := by
        let E0 : ℚ := e / n
        have quad_nonneg : 0 ≤ d / n - 2 * E0 + E0 ^ 2 := by
          have : 1 - d / n ≤ (1 - E0) ^ 2 := by
            simp only [E0]
            refine Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ) |>.mp ?_
            push_cast only [Rat.cast_pow, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_sub, Rat.cast_one,
              Rat.cast_natCast]
            exact JohnsonBound.johnson_hyp_implies_div_ineq hn_pos_nat d_le_n h
          linear_combination this
        have denom_expansion : JohnsonDenominator B' v =
            frac * H := by
          simp only [JohnsonDenominator]
          ring
        rewrite [denom_expansion, mul_div_assoc,
          mul_div_mul_left _ _ (div_pos hq_pos hq1_pos).ne']
        calc JohnsonBound.d B' / n /
                H
            ≤ d / n / (d / n - 2 * e / n + frac * (e / n) ^ 2) :=
              johnson_worst_case_bound hn_pos (Nat.succ_le_iff.1 d_not_small) d_le_n h
                (le_of_not_gt h_d_close_n) hfrac_gt1 (by
                  exact_mod_cast JohnsonBound.e_ball_le_radius (v := v) (r := e)
                    (by simpa using show 0 < B'.card by omega)) hd_le_dB' quad_nonneg $ by
                  rewrite [← mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left $ div_pos hq_pos hq1_pos,
                    ← denom_expansion]
                  exact johnson_condition_strong_iff_johnson_denom_pos.1 this
          _ ≤ _ :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_left
                (div_nonneg (mod_cast d.zero_le) hn_pos.le)
                (one_div_pos.mpr $ mul_pos hq_pos $ pow_pos hn_pos 2) (by
                  by_cases he0 : e = 0
                  subst he0
                  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, mul_zero,
                    zero_pow two_ne_zero, add_zero, sub_zero]
                  exact johnson_den_lb_e_zero hn_pos_nat (le_trans one_le_two q_not_small)
                    (mod_cast d_not_small)
                  rewrite [mul_div_assoc]
                  exact johnson_den_lb_e_pos hn_pos he0 (by
                    simp only [frac, div_sub_one hq1_pos.ne', sub_sub_cancel]
                    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hq1_pos $ sub_le_self q one_pos.le) (sub_pos.mpr hfrac_gt1) quad_nonneg)
          _ = _ := by field_simp

name: ProximityToRS.dir_close_of_many_close_pts
proof:
lemma dir_close_of_many_close_pts
    {deg : ℕ}
    {α : ι ↪ F} {e : ℕ} {u v : ι → F}
    (he : (e : ℚ≥0) < ‖(RScodeSet α deg)‖₀ / 3)
    (h_many : numberOfClosePts u v deg α e > ‖(RScodeSet α deg)‖₀) :
    Δ₀(v, ReedSolomon.code α deg) ≤ e := by unhygienic
  classical
  let CRS := ReedSolomon.code α deg
  let C := (CRS : Set $ ι → F)
  have h3e_lt : 3 * e < ‖C‖₀ := by
    with_reducible exact_mod_cast (lt_div_iff₀' zero_lt_three).mp he
  let P : F → Prop := λr ↦ Δ₀(u + r • v, C) ≤ e
  let RS := {r : F // P r}
  have hRC : ‖C‖₀ < _ :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le h_many $ by
      simpa only [numberOfClosePts] using
        Fintype.card_le_of_surjective (λr ↦ ⟨_, (Affine.mem_affineLineAtOrigin_iff u v _).2 ⟨r.1, rfl⟩, r.2⟩ : RS → closePtsOnAffineLine u v deg α e) $ by
          intro x
          rcases (Affine.mem_affineLineAtOrigin_iff u v x.1).1 x.2.1
          refine .intro ⟨w, ?_⟩ ?_
          simpa only [h] using x.2.2
          ext i
          apply congrFun h.symm
  have :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.succ_le_of_lt $ lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) h3e_lt) hRC
  have : 1 < (Finset.univ : Finset RS).card := by
    rwa [Finset.card_univ]
  obtain ⟨r0, -, r1, hr01⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp this
  choose c hc_mem hc_dist using λr : RS ↦
    Code.closeToCode_iff_closeToCodeword_of_minDist _ e |>.1 r.2
  choose E hE_card hE_agree using λr ↦
    Code.closeToWord_iff_exists_possibleDisagreeCols _ _ e |>.1 $ hc_dist r
  have hE' (r : RS) j hj : u j + r.1 * v j = _ :=
    hE_agree r j hj
  let w := (r1.1 - r0.1)⁻¹ • (c r1 - c r0)
  have hw_mem : w ∈ CRS :=
    CRS.smul_mem _ $ CRS.sub_mem (hc_mem r1) $ hc_mem r0
  have hmul r s j (hjr : j ∉ E r) (hjs : j ∉ E s) :
      (s.1 - r.1) * v j = c s j - c r j := by
    linear_combination hE' s j hjs - hE' r j hjr
  have hvw_of j (hj0 : j ∉ E r0) (hj1 : j ∉ E r1) : w j = v j := by
    dsimp only [w, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← hmul r0 r1 j hj0 hj1, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ $ sub_ne_zero.mpr λh => hr01.2 $ Subtype.ext h.symm, one_mul]
  let cBase := c r0 - r0.1 • w
  have h_codeword_eq r : c r = cBase + r.1 • w := by
    let H2 := r.1 - r0.1
    have hcRW : c r - c r0 = H2 • w := by
      have hcard_le : (E r0 ∪ E r1 ∪ E r).card ≤ 3 * e := by
        have := Finset.card_union_le (E r0 ∪ E r1) $ E r
        have := Finset.card_union_le (E r0) $ E r1
        have h2 := hE_card r0
        have := hE_card r1
        have := hE_card r
        omega
      refine Code.eq_of_lt_dist (CRS.sub_mem (hc_mem r) $ hc_mem r0)
        (CRS.smul_mem _ hw_mem) ?_
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (by
        apply hamming_dist_le_of_subset_disagree
        intro
        intro
        by_contra hiU
        have := hiU ∘ Finset.mem_union_left _ ∘ Finset.mem_union_left _
        have : (c r - c r0) j = H2 • w j := by
          rewrite [hvw_of j this $ hiU ∘ Finset.mem_union_left _ ∘ Finset.mem_union_right _]
          apply (hmul r0 r j this $ hiU ∘ Finset.mem_union_right _).symm
        exact a this) hcard_le) h3e_lt
    funext i
    have := congrFun hcRW i
    dsimp only [cBase, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply] at this ⊢
    linear_combination this
  have h_line_eq r j (hj : j ∉ E r) :
      u j + r.1 * v j = cBase j + r.1 * w j := by
    rewrite [hE' r j hj, h_codeword_eq]
    rfl
  let D := Finset.filter (λj ↦ u j ≠ cBase j ∨ v j ≠ w j) Finset.univ
  have : D.card ≤ e := by
    have h_err_ge j (hj : j ∈ D) :
        (Finset.filter (j ∈ E ·) Finset.univ).card ≥ Fintype.card RS - 1 := by
      let H1 := Finset.filter (j ∉ E ·) Finset.univ
      have : H1.card ≤ 1 := by
        apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
        iterate 4 intro
        have := h_line_eq a j (Finset.mem_filter.mp a_1).2
        have hd : (a.1 - b.1) * (v j - w j) = 0 := by
          linear_combination this - h_line_eq b j (Finset.mem_filter.mp a_2).2
        unhygienic cases mul_eq_zero.mp hd
        exact Subtype.ext $ sub_eq_zero.mp h
        rewrite [sub_eq_zero.mp h] at this
        exact nomatch (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2.elim (· $ add_right_cancel this) (· $ sub_eq_zero.mp h)
      have hpart :
          (Finset.filter (j ∈ E ·) Finset.univ).card +
              H1.card = Fintype.card RS := by
        simpa only [Finset.card_univ] using Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
          (s := Finset.univ) (p := λr ↦ j ∈ E r)
      omega
    let H := Fintype.card RS - 1
    have hkey : D.card * H ≤ Fintype.card RS * e := by
      have h := Finset.sum_le_sum h_err_ge
      rewrite [Finset.sum_const] at h
      apply h.trans
      calc _
          ≤ _ :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset λ_ _ => Finset.mem_univ _
        _ = ∑ r, (E r).card := by
            simp only [Finset.card_filter]
            rewrite [Finset.sum_comm]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl λr _ =>
              (Finset.card_eq_sum_ite $ Finset.subset_univ _).symm
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum λr _ => hE_card r
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul]
    by_contra hD_gt
    let H3 := e + 1
    have hy : H3 * H ≤ _ :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ $ Nat.succ_le_of_lt $ lt_of_not_ge hD_gt
    have h1 : H3 * H =
        e * H + H := by ring
    have h2 : Fintype.card RS * e = e * H + e := by
      have hS : Fintype.card RS = Fintype.card RS - 1 + 1 := by omega
      conv_lhs => rw [hS]
      ring
    omega
  exact le_trans (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem (u := v) (v := w) hw_mem)
 $ mod_cast le_trans (
      hamming_dist_le_of_subset_disagree (D := D)
        λj hj => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, Or.inr hj⟩) this

name: ProximityGap.RS_exists_nonzero_kernelVec_of_det_eq_zero_natDegree_le_one
proof:
theorem RS_exists_nonzero_kernelVec_of_det_eq_zero_natDegree_le_one (e : ℕ)
    (K : Matrix (Fin (e + 1)) (Fin (e + 1)) F[X])
    (hdeg : ∀ i j, (K i j).natDegree ≤ 1)
    (hdet : Matrix.det K = 0) :
    ∃ a : Fin (e + 1) → F[X],
      a ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ t, (a t).natDegree ≤ e) ∧ Matrix.mulVec K a = 0 := by unhygienic
  classical
  let n := e + 1
  let P := λr =>
    ∃ I J : Fin r ↪ Fin n, Matrix.det (K.submatrix I J) ≠ 0
  let r := n.findGreatest P
  have : P r := Nat.findGreatest_spec n.zero_le ⟨.ofIsEmpty, .ofIsEmpty, by simp⟩
  have hr_lt : r < n := lt_of_le_of_ne n.findGreatest_le λhEq => (fun ⟨I0, J0, hdet0⟩ =>
    hdet0 $ RS_det_submatrix_eq_zero_of_det_eq_zero n K hdet I0 J0) $ hEq ▸ this
  have hnotP_succ := Nat.findGreatest_is_greatest r.lt_succ_self hr_lt
  rcases this with ⟨I, J, hIJ⟩
  have hout (f : Fin r ↪ Fin n) : ∃ i, i ∉ Set.range f :=
    Classical.byContradiction λh => r.lt_irrefl $ hr_lt.trans_le $ by
      simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Fintype.card_le_of_surjective f
        λy => Classical.byContradiction λhc => h $ .intro y hc
  rcases hout I
  rcases hout J
  let I' := Fin.Embedding.snoc I h
  let J' := Fin.Embedding.snoc J h_1
  let B := K.submatrix I' J'
  let u := λt => B.adjugate t $ Fin.last r
  have : B.mulVec u = 0 :=
    RS_mulVec_adjugate_col_eq_zero_of_det_eq_zero r.succ B _ $
      Classical.byContradiction λh => hnotP_succ ⟨I', J', h⟩
  have hu_deg t : (u t).natDegree ≤ e := by
    have hP0 k : ((-1 : F[X]) ^ k).natDegree = 0 := by simp
    rewrite [show u t = _ * Matrix.det _ from
      RS_adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix_last_castSucc (B := B) (t := t)]
    apply le_trans Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le ..
    rewrite [hP0, zero_add]
    apply (RS_natDegree_det_le_of_entry_natDegree_le_one r _ λi j =>
      hdeg ..).trans $ Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hr_lt
  let a := Function.extend J' u $ λ_ => 0
  have hau : ∀ t, a _ = _ := J'.injective.extend_apply u _
  have hmulVec_eq i :=
    rfl.trans
      (Fintype.sum_of_injective _ J'.injective
        _ (λj => K i j * a j)
        λj hj => by
          simp [a, ↓Function.extend_apply' u _ j hj]
        λt => congrArg _ (hau t).symm).symm
  refine ⟨a, λha0 => (show B.adjugate _ _ ≠ 0 by
    rewrite [RS_adjugate_last_last_eq_det_submatrix_castSucc_castSucc,
      show B.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc = K.submatrix I J from
        by simp only [Fin.Embedding.coe_snoc, submatrix_submatrix, Fin.snoc_comp_castSucc, B, I', J']]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ $ neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero) hIJ) $ (hau _).symm.trans $ congrFun ha0 _, λt => by
    by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.range J'
    rcases ht with ⟨s, rfl⟩
    exact hau s ▸ hu_deg s
    simp [show a t = 0 from Function.extend_apply' u _ t ht], by
      funext
      by_cases hi : x ∈ Set.range I
      rcases hi with ⟨t, rfl⟩
      exact (hmulVec_eq _).trans $ by
        simpa [B, I', Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using congrArg (· t.castSucc) this
      let Ii := Fin.Embedding.snoc I hi
      let b := λj => K x $ J' j
      exact (hmulVec_eq x).trans $
        (det_updateRow_eq_sum_mul_adjugate_col B _ b).symm.trans
          (show B.updateRow (Fin.last r) b = K.submatrix Ii J' by
            ext
            induction i using Fin.lastCases <;> simp [B, I', Ii, b] ▸ Classical.byContradiction λh => hnotP_succ ⟨Ii, J', h⟩)⟩

name: ProximityGap.RS_jointAgreement_of_goodCoeffs_card_gt
proof:
theorem RS_jointAgreement_of_goodCoeffs_card_gt {deg : ℕ} {domain : ι ↪ F} {δ : ℝ≥0}
    (hδ : δ ≤ relativeUniqueDecodingRadius (ι := ι) (F := F)
      (C := ReedSolomon.code domain deg))
    (u : WordStack F (Fin 2) ι)
    (hS : (RS_goodCoeffs (deg := deg) (domain := domain) u δ).card > Fintype.card ι) :
    jointAgreement (C := ReedSolomon.code domain deg) (δ := δ) (W := u) := by set_option smartUnfolding false in set_option backward.isDefEq.lazyProjDelta false in set_option backward.isDefEq.lazyWhnfCore false in set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in unhygienic
  classical
  let n := Fintype.card ι
  let e := Nat.floor $ δ * n
  set good : Finset F := RS_goodCoeffs u δ
  by_cases hdeg_zero : deg = 0
  · subst hdeg_zero
    let S0 := Finset.univ.filter λi => u 0 i = 0 ∧ u 1 i = 0
    have hcode0_zero : ∀ w ∈ (ReedSolomon.code domain 0 : Set $ ι → F), w = 0 := by
      simp only [ReedSolomon.code_zero, Submodule.bot_coe, Set.mem_singleton_iff, imp_self, implies_true]
    have hsum_lower :
        good.card * (n - e) ≤ good.sum λz => (Finset.univ.filter $ λi => u 0 i + z * u 1 i = 0).card := by
      refine le_trans ?_
        (Finset.sum_le_sum λz hz => by
          rcases Code.relCloseToWord_iff_exists_agreementCols
                      (u := u 0 + z • u 1) (v := 0) (δ := δ).1 $ by
                        obtain ⟨w, hwmem, hwdist⟩ :=
                          (Code.relCloseToCode_iff_relCloseToCodeword_of_minDist ..).1 $
                            (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).2
                        rwa [← hcode0_zero w hwmem]
          exact h.1.trans $ Finset.card_le_card (by
            intro
            intro
            have hi_eq : u 0 a + z * u 1 a = 0 := (h.2 a).1 a_1
            simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, hi_eq]))
      rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
    have hcount_bound i : (good.filter $ λz => u 0 i + z * u 1 i = 0).card
            ≤ if i ∈ S0 then good.card else 1 := by
      by_cases hcommon : u 0 i = 0 ∧ u 1 i = 0
      simp [S0, hcommon]
      have hcard_le_one :
          (good.filter (u 0 i + · * u 1 i = 0)).card ≤ 1 := by
        rcases Classical.em _ with hu1 | hu1
        have : u 0 i ≠ 0 := λthis => hcommon $ .intro this hu1
        simp [hu1, this]
        exact Finset.card_le_one.mpr λz1 hz1 z2 hz2 =>
          mul_right_cancel₀ hu1 $ by
            rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right $ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz1).2, eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz2).2]
      rwa [if_neg $ by simp [S0, hcommon]]
    refine ⟨S0,
      (Code.relDist_floor_bound_iff_complement_bound n S0.card δ).mp (by
        by_contra
        have hkey : good.card * (n - e) < good.card * (S0.card + 1) := by
          calc good.card * (n - e)
              ≤ S0.card * good.card + (n - S0.card) := 
                hsum_lower.trans $ (le_of_eq $ by
                  simp only [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter]
                  rw [Finset.sum_comm]).trans $ le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum λi _ => hcount_bound i) $ le_of_eq $ by
                      rw [← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl
                        ,
                        Finset.sum_congr rfl λx hx => if_pos hx,
                        Finset.sum_congr rfl λx hx => if_neg $ Finset.mem_compl.mp hx,
                        Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_one,
                        Finset.card_compl]
            _ < _ := Nat.add_lt_add_left (lt_of_le_of_lt (n.sub_le S0.card) hS) _
            _ = _ := by ring
        exact absurd hkey $ Nat.not_lt.2 $ Nat.mul_le_mul_left good.card $ Nat.succ_le_of_lt $ lt_of_not_ge this), ?_⟩
    use Code.finMapTwoWords 0 0
    intros
    fin_cases i
    all_goals
      constructor
      apply (ReedSolomon.code domain 0).zero_mem
      intro
      intro
      simp only [finMapTwoWords, Pi.zero_apply, Fin.zero_eta, mem_filter, mem_univ, (Finset.mem_filter.mp a_1).2.1, and_self, Fin.mk_one, (Finset.mem_filter.mp a_1).2.2]
  · by_cases hdeg_le : deg ≤ n
    · letI : NeZero deg := ⟨hdeg_zero⟩
      have h2e : 2 * e + deg ≤ n := by
        have hBW : 2 * e < _ :=
          RS_BW_bound_of_le_relUDR hdeg_le hδ
        omega
      have hgood_pos := Fintype.card_pos.trans hS
      haveI : Nonempty (Finset.univ.map domain) :=
        Finset.univ_nonempty.map.to_subtype
      haveI : Nonempty good :=
        (Finset.card_pos.mp hgood_pos).to_subtype
      have evalY_natDegree_le_degreeX z (f : F[X][Y]) :
          (Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY z f).natDegree ≤ Polynomial.Bivariate.degreeX f := by
        simp only [Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY, Polynomial.eval_eq_sum]
        refine le_trans (Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le ..) $ Finset.sup_le λj _ => ?_
        exact le_trans
          (by simpa only [Polynomial.C_pow, Function.comp_apply] using
            Polynomial.natDegree_mul_C_le (f := f.coeff j) (a := z ^ j))
          (Polynomial.Bivariate.coeff_natDegree_le_degreeX f j)
      have evalX_eval_eq_evalY_eval (x z : F) f :
          (Polynomial.Bivariate.evalX x f).eval z = (Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY z f).eval x := by
        simpa only [ps_eval_x_eq_map, Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY,
          Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom, Polynomial.eval_C] using
          Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply
            (f := Polynomial.evalRingHom x) (r := Polynomial.C z)
      obtain ⟨A, B, hAB⟩ :=
        RS_exists_bivariate_AB_of_goodCoeffs_card_gt
          hdeg_le hδ u hS
      let quot_x := λz =>
        if hz : z ∈ good then
          Classical.choose $ RS_exists_Pz_of_mem_goodCoeffs
            u hz
        else 0
      let quot_y := λx =>
        Polynomial.C (u 0 $ Function.invFun domain x) +
          Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (u 1 $ Function.invFun domain x)
      have hyq i :
          quot_y (domain i) = Polynomial.C (u 0 i) + Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (u 1 i) := by
        simp only [quot_y, Function.leftInverse_invFun domain.injective i]
      let nq : ℚ := (.mk n Fintype.card_pos : ℕ+)
      have :
          1 > (e + deg - 1 : ℕ) / nq + (e + 1 : ℕ) / (.mk good.card hgood_pos : ℕ+) := by
        have hfrac_lt : _ < _ / nq :=
          div_lt_div_of_pos_left (Nat.cast_pos.mpr e.succ_pos) (Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos)
            (Nat.cast_lt.mpr hS)
        have hle_one : _ / nq ≤ 1 :=
          (div_le_one $ Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos).mpr $ Nat.cast_le.mpr h2e
        apply lt_of_lt_of_le (add_lt_add_right hfrac_lt _)
        rewrite [← add_div, ← Nat.cast_add,
          show e + deg - 1 + e.succ = 2 * e + deg by omega]
        assumption
      obtain ⟨P, _, hP_degX, _, ⟨Q_x, hQx_card, hQx_eval⟩, _⟩ :=
        polishchuk_spielman
          (a_x := e) (a_y := e) (b_x := e + deg - 1) (b_y := e + 1)
          (n_x := .mk n Fintype.card_pos) (n_y := .mk good.card hgood_pos)
          (h_bx_ge_ax := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt
            (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right $ Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hdeg_zero))
          (h_by_ge_ay := e.le_succ)
          (A := A) (B := B) hAB.1 hAB.2.1 hAB.2.2.2.1 hAB.2.2.1 hAB.2.2.2.2.1
          (Finset.univ.map domain) good quot_x quot_y
          (by
            simp [n]) le_rfl (by
              intros
              have hspec := RS_exists_Pz_of_mem_goodCoeffs
                u a
              let Pz := hspec.choose
              have hPz :
                  Pz.natDegree < deg ∧
                    Δ₀(u 0 + y • u 1, Pz.eval ∘ domain) ≤ e :=
                hspec.choose_spec
              have hquot_def : quot_x y = Pz := dif_pos a
              constructor
              rw [hquot_def, Nat.add_sub_assoc $ Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hdeg_zero,
                Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
              apply Nat.le_pred_of_lt hPz.1
              let Dz := Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY y B - Pz * Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY y A
              rcases Code.closeToWord_iff_exists_agreementCols
                          (u := u 0 + y • u 1) (v := Pz.eval ∘ domain) (e := e).1 hPz.2
              have :
                  Dz.natDegree ≤ e + deg - 1 := by
                have : _ ≤ e :=
                  le_trans (evalY_natDegree_le_degreeX y A) hAB.2.1
                exact le_trans (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le ..) $ max_le (
                  le_trans (evalY_natDegree_le_degreeX y B) hAB.2.2.2.1) $ by
                  refine le_trans Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le
                     ?_
                  omega
              have :=
                Polynomial.eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero'
                  (p := Dz) (s := w.image domain) (by
                    intros
                    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp a_1 with ⟨i, hiTz, rfl⟩
                    have : u 0 i + y * u 1 i = Pz.eval _ := (h.2 i).1 hiTz
                    simp only [Dz, Polynomial.eval_sub, sub_eq_zero]
                    rw [← evalX_eval_eq_evalY_eval, hAB.2.2.2.2.2]
                    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_X,
                      Polynomial.eval_C, this, evalX_eval_eq_evalY_eval]) $ by
                    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ domain.injective]
                    clear hPz
                    omega
              rwa [hquot_def, ← sub_eq_zero]) (by
            intros
            rcases Finset.mem_map.mp a with ⟨i, -, rfl⟩
            constructor
            rw [hyq, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
            refine le_trans (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le ..) $ max_le ?_ ?_
            simp
            exact le_trans (Polynomial.natDegree_mul_C_le (f := Polynomial.X) (a := u 1 i))
              (le_of_eq Polynomial.natDegree_X)
            rw [hyq]
            exact hAB.2.2.2.2.2 i) this
      let S0 := Q_x.preimage domain domain.injective.injOn
      have hv_mem j : (P.coeff j).eval ∘ domain ∈ ReedSolomon.code domain deg := by
        refine ⟨P.coeff j, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.2 ?_, rfl⟩
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt Polynomial.degree_le_natDegree
          (mod_cast
            lt_of_le_of_lt (
              le_trans (Polynomial.Bivariate.coeff_natDegree_le_degreeX P j) $ by
                rwa [Nat.add_sub_assoc $ Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hdeg_zero, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at hP_degX) $ Nat.pred_lt $ NeZero.ne deg)
      have h1 j i : (P.coeff j).eval (domain i) = (evalX (domain i) P).coeff j := by
        simp [ps_eval_x_eq_map]
      have hy01 i :
          (quot_y $ domain i).coeff 0 = u 0 i ∧ (quot_y $ domain i).coeff 1 = u 1 i := by
        simp [hyq]
      refine ⟨S0,
        (Code.relDist_floor_bound_iff_complement_bound n S0.card δ).mp (by
          have : S0.card = Q_x.card := by
            rewrite [Q_x.card_preimage]
            exact congrArg Finset.card
              (Finset.filter_eq_self.2 λx hx => Set.mem_range.2 $ by
                obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp $ hQx_eval.1 hx
                exact .intro i rfl)
          rewrite [this]
          assumption), ?_⟩
      use Code.finMapTwoWords ((P.coeff 0).eval ∘ domain) $ (P.coeff 1).eval ∘ domain
      intros
      fin_cases i
      all_goals
        constructor
        first | exact hv_mem 0 | exact hv_mem 1
        intro
        intro
        simp [h1, h1,
          hQx_eval.2 _ $ Finset.mem_preimage.mp a_1, (hy01 a).1, (hy01 a).2]
    have hp_mem (p : F[X]) w
        (hp_eval : ∀ i, p.eval (domain i) = w i)
        (hp_deg : p.degree < Fintype.card ι) :
        w ∈ ReedSolomon.code domain deg := by
      refine ⟨p, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.2 $ hp_deg.trans $ mod_cast Nat.lt_of_not_ge hdeg_le,
        ?_⟩
      ext
      apply hp_eval
    have hlag w : (Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ domain w).degree < _ ∧
          ∀ i, (Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ domain w).eval _ = w i :=
      ⟨Lagrange.degree_interpolate_lt (r := w)
        λx _ y _ hxy => domain.injective hxy,
        λi =>
        Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node (r := w)
          (λx _ y _ hxy => domain.injective hxy) $ Finset.mem_univ i⟩
    refine ⟨Finset.univ, by
      simp only [card_univ, Nat.cast_pos, Fintype.zero_lt_card, mul_le_iff_le_one_left, tsub_le_iff_right, le_add_iff_nonneg_right, zero_le], ?_⟩
    use Code.finMapTwoWords (u 0) $ u 1
    intros
    fin_cases i
    all_goals
      constructor
      first
       | exact hp_mem _ (u 0) (hlag $ u 0).2 (hlag $ u 0).1
       | exact hp_mem _ (u 1) (hlag $ u 1).2 (hlag $ u 1).1
      intros
      simp

name: Sumcheck.Spec.SingleRound.Simple.reduction_perfectCompleteness
proof:
theorem reduction_perfectCompleteness :
    (reduction R deg D oSpec).perfectCompleteness init impl
      (inputRelation R deg D) (outputRelation R deg) := by
  simp only [Reduction.perfectCompleteness, Reduction.completeness, ENNReal.coe_zero, tsub_zero]
  intro oStmt () hValid
  dsimp only [reduction, Reduction.run, Prover.run, Verifier.run, prover, verifier, Prover.runToRound, Prover.processRound, Fin.induction_two]
  simp -iota only [bind_pure_comp,
    MonadLift.monadLift, liftM, MonadLiftT.monadLift,
    OracleComp.liftComp_pure, map_pure, guard]
  rewrite [ge_iff_le, one_le_probEvent_iff, probEvent_eq_one_iff]
  constructor
  simp -dsimp only [OptionT.probFailure_eq, OptionT.run_mk, probFailure_eq_zero, zero_add]
  apply probOutput_eq_zero_of_not_mem_support
  simp only [support_bind, Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists]
  intro s _ hmem
  rewrite [StateT.run'_eq, support_map] at hmem
  obtain ⟨⟨_, s'⟩, hmem, rfl⟩ := hmem
  erw [simulateQ_bind, StateT.run_bind, mem_support_bind_iff] at hmem
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s''⟩, hx, hs⟩ := hmem

  obtain ⟨⟨val, s₀⟩, hval, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩ := hx
  erw [simulateQ_bind, StateT.run_bind, mem_support_bind_iff] at hs
  obtain ⟨⟨y, s'''⟩, hy, hs⟩ := hs
  erw [simulateQ_map, simulateQ_map, StateT.run_map, support_map] at hy
  obtain ⟨⟨val2, s₁⟩, hval2, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩ := hy
  cases val2
  erw [simulateQ_bind, StateT.run_bind, mem_support_bind_iff] at hval
  obtain ⟨_, hchal, hval⟩ := hval
  erw [simulateQ_bind, StateT.run_bind, mem_support_bind_iff] at hchal
  obtain ⟨⟨discr_val, s_d⟩, hchal_fst, hchal_rest⟩ := hchal
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hchal_fst
  erw [simulateQ_map, StateT.run_map, support_map] at hchal_rest
  obtain ⟨⟨inner_val, s_inner⟩, hinner, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩ := hchal_rest
  dsimp only at hval
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hval
  erw [if_pos hValid] at hval2
  simp only [map_pure, OptionT.run_pure, simulateQ_pure, StateT.run_pure, support_pure, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Prod.mk.injEq, reduceCtorEq] at hval2
  exact hval2.1
  cases congr_arg Prod.fst hs
  intro x hx
  simp -dsimp only [OptionT.mem_support_iff, OptionT.run_mk, support_bind, Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
  obtain ⟨s, _, hx⟩ := hx
  rewrite [StateT.run'_eq, support_map] at hx

name: ps_coprime_case_constant
proof:
lemma ps_coprime_case_constant {F : Type} [Field F]
    (a_x a_y b_x b_y : ℕ) (n_x n_y : ℕ+)
    (h_bx_ge_ax : b_x ≥ a_x) (h_by_ge_ay : b_y ≥ a_y)
    (A B : F[X][Y]) (hA0 : A ≠ 0) (hB0 : B ≠ 0) (hrel : IsRelPrime A B)
    (h_f_degX : a_x ≥ degreeX A) (h_g_degX : b_x ≥ degreeX B)
    (h_f_degY : a_y ≥ natDegreeY A) (h_g_degY : b_y ≥ natDegreeY B)
    (P_x P_y : Finset F) [Nonempty P_x] [Nonempty P_y]
    (quot_x quot_y : F → F[X])
    (h_card_Px : n_x ≤ P_x.card) (h_card_Py : n_y ≤ P_y.card)
    (h_quot_x : ∀ y ∈ P_y, (quot_x y).natDegree ≤ (b_x - a_x) ∧
      evalY y B = (quot_x y) * (evalY y A))
    (h_quot_y : ∀ x ∈ P_x, (quot_y x).natDegree ≤ (b_y - a_y) ∧
      evalX x B = (quot_y x) * (evalX x A))
    (h_le_1 : 1 > (b_x : ℚ) / (n_x : ℚ) + (b_y : ℚ) / (n_y : ℚ)) :
    degreeX A = 0 ∧ natDegreeY A = 0 := by
  unhygienic
  set mY := natDegreeY A
  set mX := degreeX A with hmX
  with_reducible set RX := resultant _ (swap A) b_x mX with hRX
  have := pairwise_coprime_X_sub_C (K := F) Function.injective_id
  have hdeg_prod (S : Finset F) m :
      (∏ x ∈ S, (X - C x) ^ m).natDegree = m * S.card := by
    simp [X_sub_C_ne_zero, natDegree_prod, Nat.mul_comm]
  -- Upper bounds from resultant degree
  have hmy_le_D :=
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h_card_Px).trans
      (((hdeg_prod P_x mY).symm.le.trans $ natDegree_le_of_dvd (
        Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime (λ_ _ _ _ hxy ↦ (this hxy).pow) λx hx ↦ by
          rcases h_quot_y x hx
          apply ps_resultant_dvd_pow_eval_x _ _ _ _ b_y (h_f_degY.trans h_by_ge_ay) h_g_degY
            (left.trans $ Nat.sub_le_sub_left h_f_degY b_y) right)
        (ps_resultant_ne_zero_of_is_rel_prime _ _ b_y h_g_degY hA0 hrel)).trans
        (le_trans (ps_nat_degree_resultant_le A B mY b_y)
          (Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h_g_degX) (b_y.mul_comm mX).le)))
  have hmx_le_D :=
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h_card_Py).trans
      (((hdeg_prod P_y mX).symm.le.trans $ natDegree_le_of_dvd (        Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime (λ_ _ _ _ hyy' ↦ (this hyy').pow) λy hy ↦ by
          rcases h_quot_x y hy
          apply ps_resultant_dvd_pow_eval_y A B y _ b_x (h_f_degX.trans h_bx_ge_ax)
            h_g_degX (left.trans $ Nat.sub_le_sub_left h_f_degX b_x) right : _ ∣ RX) $ by
        rewrite [hRX, hmX, ← ps_nat_degree_y_swap]
        apply ps_resultant_ne_zero_of_is_rel_prime _ _ b_x
          (le_of_eq_of_le (ps_nat_degree_y_swap B) h_g_degX)
          (by simpa using swap.injective.ne hA0) $ ps_is_rel_prime_swap hrel).trans
        ((ps_nat_degree_resultant_le _ _ mX b_x).trans $ by
          simp only [ps_degree_x_swap]
          apply Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h_g_degY) (b_x.mul_comm mY).le))
  suffices hD : mX * b_y + mY * b_x = 0 by
    refine ⟨(mul_eq_zero.mp $ Nat.le_zero.mp $ hmx_le_D.trans hD.le).resolve_right
      (Nat.ne_of_gt n_y.pos),
      (mul_eq_zero.mp ?_).resolve_right $ Nat.ne_of_gt n_x.pos⟩
    omega
  by_contra hD0
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (b_x * n_y.val) hmy_le_D
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (b_y * n_x.val) hmx_le_D
  have := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (?_ : b_x * n_y.val + n_x.val * b_y < n_x.val * n_y.val) $ Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hD0
  clear h_le_1 hdeg_prod h_quot_x h_quot_y hA0 quot_x quot_y hB0
  grind
  field_simp at h_le_1
  exact_mod_cast h_le_1

proof:
theorem erlv_case12_other_d1_bone_impossible
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P : Fin n → Point ℝ} {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℝ}
    (S : ErLVAtVertexUseSite P d₁ d₂ d₃) (h12 : S.Case12)

    (hBOne : S.pair.first.leftMoves = 1) : False := by

  let q := cyclicAdvance S.x 2

  let z := firstClockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ S.x
  let s := cyclicRetreat z 1
  have hOffsets := erlv_u_z_offset_data S

  have hzIndex : z = _ := hOffsets.2.2.2.2
  have hsIndex : s = _ :=
    (congrArg (cyclicRetreat · 1) hzIndex).trans
      (cyclicRetreat_advance S.x
        (Nat.one_le_of_lt hOffsets.2.1) hOffsets.2.2.1)
  have := erlv_case12_shared_tip_rank_data S h12
  have hpu : sqDist _ (P u) = d₁ := this.1
  have hqu : sqDist (P q) (P u) = d₂ := this.2.2
  rewrite [hBOne] at hOther
  have hps : sqDist _ (P s) = d₁ := (sqDist_comm ..).trans hOther
  have hpp := hpu.trans hps.symm
  have hQUAD := erlv_x_p_u_z_strict_convex_quad S
  have h6 := high_degree_le_six_false S S.x
  have htop₂ : ∀ {b}, d₂ < b → b = d₁ ∨ b = d₂ ∨ b = d₃ → b = d₁ := by
    rintro b hab (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    rfl
    refine nomatch hab.ne rfl
    refine (S.classes.1.trans hab).ne rfl |>.elim
  have := equal_radius_arc_strict_order (by
    rewrite [huIndex, hsIndex]
    refine cyclic_strict_convex_quad_offsets S.convex S.x
      Nat.one_lt_two h2u huS hsoffn) hpp
  have hqs :=
    htop₂ (lt_of_eq_of_lt hqu.symm this) (top_three_adjacent_of_strictly_longer
      S.classes ⟨huIndex ▸ cyclicAdvance_ne_of_lt S.x (h2u.trans hun) hun h2u.ne,
        Or.inr $ Or.inl hqu⟩ this).2
  cases hBOne ▸ h12.1 ▸ S.pair.first.path
  any_goals cases tail
  have hMid := left_cover_top_three_adjacent S.classes S.first_start_adjacent hCover
  have hbd := lt_of_lt_of_le hCover_1 hOther.le
  rcases ((strict_top_three_rank_slots S.classes S.first_start_adjacent hMid hCover).resolve_left
        λh => hbd.ne h.2).resolve_left
      λh => hbd.ne h.2
  have hxsLtXu : sqDist (P S.x) (P s) < sqDist (P S.x) (P u) := by
    have hed := edge_diagonal_inequality_rotated $ by
      have hquad := cyclic_strict_convex_quad_offsets S.convex S.x
        Nat.zero_lt_one (Nat.one_lt_two.trans h2u) huS hsoffn
      rwa [← huIndex, ← hsIndex, cyclicAdvance_zero] at hquad
    rewrite [euclideanDist_eq_of_sqDist_eq hpp] at hed
    refine sqDist_lt_of_euclideanDist_lt $ lt_of_add_lt_add_left hed
  have hxu :=
    htop₂ (lt_of_eq_of_lt (right.symm.trans $ sqDist_comm ..) hxsLtXu)
      (top_three_adjacent_of_strictly_longer S.classes
        (topThreeAdjacent_symm hMid) hxsLtXu).2
  have :=
    far_arc_strict_center_comparison hQUAD (hxu.trans hpu.symm).le
  refine h6 $ (maximal_gap_tail_degree_bounds S hpu ((sqDist_comm ..).trans left) $ by
    rcases (top_three_adjacent_of_strictly_longer S.classes
      (topThreeAdjacent_symm S.first_start_adjacent) this).2 with h | h | h
    have : StrictConvexQuad (P p) (P q) (P s) (P z) := by
      rewrite [hsIndex, hzIndex]
      refine cyclic_strict_convex_quad_offsets S.convex S.x
        Nat.one_lt_two (h2u.trans huS) hsz hOffsets.2.2.1
    refine (lt_of_lt_of_le (equal_radius_arc_strict_order this
        (hps.trans h.symm))
      (top_three_class_bounds_of_ne S.classes
        (hzIndex ▸ cyclicAdvance_ne_of_lt S.x (h2u.trans hun)
          hOffsets.2.2.1 ((h2u.trans huS).trans hsz).ne)).1).ne hqs |>.elim
    assumption
    rewrite [(sqDist_comm ..).trans left, h] at this
    refine nomatch this.ne rfl).1 hxu
  have : sqDist (P p) (P z) < d₁ := by
    rewrite [sqDist_comm ..]
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le hCover_1 hOther.le
  rcases ((strict_top_three_rank_slots S.classes (topThreeAdjacent_symm S.first_start_adjacent)
        (topThreeAdjacent_symm
          (right_cover_top_three_adjacent S.classes S.first_start_adjacent hCover))
 $ by
          rewrite [sqDist_comm .., sqDist_comm _ $ P z]
          refine hCover).resolve_left λh => this.ne h.2).resolve_left
      λh => this.ne h.2
  have := maximal_gap_tail_degree_bounds S hpu left right
  rcases d1_d3_opposite_sides_force_xu_top_two S.classes hQUAD
    (topThreeAdjacent_symm S.first_start_adjacent) hpu left right with

  refine h6 $ this.1 hxuD₁
  refine h6 $ (this.2 hxuD₂).trans $ Nat.le_succ 5

name: CoxeterSystem.matsumoto_reduced_aux
proof:
theorem matsumoto_reduced_aux [MatsumotoCondition cs] (p : ℕ) (l l' : List B)
(len_l_eq_p : l.length = p) (len_l'_eq_p : l'.length = p)
(l_reduced : cs.IsReduced l) (l'_reduced : cs.IsReduced l') (h_eq : π l = π l') :
  ∃ bms : List (cs.BraidMove), cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms l = l' := by unhygienic
  revert l l'
  induction p with
  | zero =>
    intros
    rewrite[List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp len_l_eq_p, List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp len_l'_eq_p]
    exact .intro [] rfl
  | succ p ih =>
    intros
    obtain ⟨i, l_t, rfl, len_l_t_eq_p⟩ := cons_of_length_succ l len_l_eq_p
    obtain ⟨j, l'_t, rfl, len_l'_t_eq_p⟩ := cons_of_length_succ l' len_l'_eq_p
    by_cases first_letter_eq : i = j
    subst first_letter_eq
    exact cs.matsumoto_reduced_inductionStep_of_firstLetterEq p l_t l'_t _ len_l_t_eq_p
      len_l'_t_eq_p h_eq l_reduced l'_reduced ih
    cases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' $ MatsumotoCondition.one_le_M cs i j
    have sw u : π (braidWord M j i ++ u) = π (braidWord M i j ++ u) := by simp [↓wordProd_append, cs.wordProd_braidWord_eq j]
    have bs a b u : cs.applyBraidMove (BraidMove.mk a b 0) (braidWord M a b ++ u) =
        braidWord M b a ++ u := by
      rw[applyBraidMove, ← length_alternatingWord a b $ M a b, ite_eq_left List.take_left,
        List.drop_left]
    by_cases m_even : Even w
    unhygienic
      rcases cs.prefix_braidWord l'_t l_t j i (Ne.symm first_letter_eq)
        h_eq.symm l'_reduced l_reduced
      rcases h_1
    apply cs.concatenate_braidMove_sequences _ $ braidWord M j i ++ w_1
    simp only [braidWord, h, M.symmetric, alternatingWord_succ', ↓ite_eq_left m_even,
      List.cons_append] at left right ⊢
    exact cs.matsumoto_reduced_inductionStep_of_firstLetterEq p l_t _ i
      len_l_t_eq_p
      (Nat.add_right_cancel
        (cs.eq_length_of_isReduced _ _ left l'_reduced right) ▸
        len_l'_t_eq_p) (h_eq.trans left) l_reduced right ih
    apply cs.concatenate_braidMove_sequences
    exact .intro [BraidMove.mk j i 0] $ bs j i w_1
    have := by
      refine cs.isReduced_of_eq_length _
        _ ?_ (sw w_1) right
      simp only [List.length_append, length_alternatingWord, M.symmetric]
    have hb' := left.trans $ sw w_1
    simp only [braidWord, h, alternatingWord_succ', ↓ite_eq_left m_even] at hb' this ⊢
    exact cs.matsumoto_reduced_inductionStep_of_firstLetterEq p _ l'_t j
      (Nat.add_right_cancel
        (cs.eq_length_of_isReduced _ _ hb' l'_reduced this) ▸
        len_l'_t_eq_p) len_l'_t_eq_p hb'.symm this l'_reduced ih
    unhygienic
      rcases cs.prefix_braidWord l_t l'_t i j first_letter_eq h_eq l_reduced l'_reduced
      rcases h_1
    apply cs.concatenate_braidMove_sequences _ $ braidWord M i j ++ w_1
    simp only [braidWord, h, alternatingWord_succ', ↓ite_eq_right m_even] at left right ⊢
    exact cs.matsumoto_reduced_inductionStep_of_firstLetterEq p l_t _ i
      len_l_t_eq_p
      (Nat.add_right_cancel
        (cs.eq_length_of_isReduced _ _ left l_reduced right) ▸
        len_l_t_eq_p) left l_reduced right ih
    apply cs.concatenate_braidMove_sequences
    exact .intro [BraidMove.mk i j 0] $ bs i j w_1
    have hb' := h_eq.symm.trans $ left.trans (sw w_1).symm
    have := by
      refine cs.isReduced_of_eq_length _
        _ ?_ (sw w_1).symm right
      simp only [List.length_append, length_alternatingWord, M.symmetric]
    simp only [braidWord, h, M.symmetric, alternatingWord_succ', ↓ite_eq_right m_even] at hb' this ⊢
    exact cs.matsumoto_reduced_inductionStep_of_firstLetterEq p _ l'_t j
      (Nat.add_right_cancel
        (cs.eq_length_of_isReduced _ _ hb' l'_reduced this) ▸
        len_l'_t_eq_p) len_l'_t_eq_p hb'.symm this l'_reduced ih

name: Vlasov.transportedIntegral_continuousOn
proof:
theorem transportedIntegral_continuousOn
    (gradW : PhysSpace d → PhysSpace d)
    (f : ℝ → Measure (PhaseSpace d)) (T : ℝ)
    (hf_mom : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, HasFiniteFirstMoment (f t))
    (hf_narrow : ∀ (g : PhaseSpace d → ℝ), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g →
      ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ z, g z ∂(f s)) (Set.Icc 0 T))
    (charX charV : ℝ → PhaseSpace d → PhysSpace d)
    (hflow : IsCharacteristicFlowOn gradW (fun t => spatialMarginal (f t)) charX charV
      (Set.Ioo 0 T) Set.univ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)
    (φ : PhaseSpace d → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (Ψ : ℝ → PhaseSpace d → PhaseSpace d)
    (hΨ_left : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
      Function.LeftInverse (Ψ s) (fun z => (charX s z, charV s z)))
    (hΨ_right : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
      Function.RightInverse (Ψ s) (fun z => (charX s z, charV s z)))
    (hΨ_C1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun p : ℝ × PhaseSpace d => Ψ p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Ioo 0 T ×ˢ Set.univ))
    (hΦt_C1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun z : PhaseSpace d => (charX t z, charV t z)))
    (L : NNReal)
    (hflowjoint : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × PhaseSpace d => (charX p.1 p.2, charV p.1 p.2))
      (Set.Icc 0 T ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (PhaseSpace d))))
    (hanti : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ z₁ z₂ : PhaseSpace d,
      dist z₁ z₂ ≤ dist ((charX s z₁, charV s z₁) : PhaseSpace d) (charX s z₂, charV s z₂)
        * Real.exp (((max 1 L : NNReal) : ℝ) * s)) :
    ContinuousOn (fun s => if s = 0 then ∫ z, φ (charX t z, charV t z) ∂(f 0)
        else ∫ z, φ (charX t (Ψ s z), charV t (Ψ s z)) ∂(f s)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t) := by set_option smartUnfolding false in set_option backward.isDefEq.lazyWhnfCore false in
  let g := λz => φ (charX t z, charV t z)
  with_reducible_and_instances have : Continuous g := hφ.continuous.comp' hΦt_C1.continuous
  have hΨco : ContinuousOn (λp : ℝ × PhaseSpace d => Ψ p.1 p.2)
      _ := hΨ_C1.continuousOn
  let S := Ψ t '' tsupport φ
  have hg_supp_S : ∀ z ∉ S, g z = 0 := λz hz =>
    Classical.byContradiction λhgz =>
      hz ⟨_,
        subset_tsupport φ $ Function.mem_support.mpr hgz, hΨ_left t ht z⟩
  have hinit z : (charX 0 z, charV 0 z) = z :=
    Prod.ext (hflow.1 z $ Set.mem_univ z).1 (hflow.1 z $ Set.mem_univ z).2
  let u := λs => max 0 $ min s t
  have hminIoo_gen : ∀ s > 0, min s t ∈ Set.Ioo _ T := λs hs =>
    ⟨lt_min hs ht.1, (min_le_right ..).trans_lt ht.2⟩
  let G' := λs z => g $ if s ≤ 0 then z else Ψ (min s t) z
  let Ktot := (λq ↦ (charX q.1 q.2, charV q.1 q.2)) '' Set.Icc 0 t ×ˢ S
  refine (vlasovSolutionOn_integral_continuousOn f T hf_mom hf_narrow G'
    (by
      rewrite [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      unhygienic rintro ⟨⟩
      rcases lt_trichotomy fst 0 with hs₀ | rfl | hs₀
      exact (this.comp continuous_snd).continuousAt.congr
        (Filter.Eventually.mono ((isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const).mem_nhds hs₀)
          λp hp => congrArg g (ite_eq_left hp.le).symm)
      rewrite [Metric.continuousAt_iff']
      simp only [G', if_pos le_rfl]
      intro ε hε
      with_reducible obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδg⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp this.continuousAt ε hε
      have : Tendsto _ (𝓝 ((0 : ℝ), snd)) _ := continuous_snd.continuousAt
      have hd : Tendsto (λp => dist p.2 (charX (u p.1) snd, charV (u p.1) snd)
            * Real.exp (max 1 L * t)) (𝓝 (0, snd)) (𝓝 0) := by
        have hj : ContinuousAt (λp => (charX (u p.1) snd, charV (u p.1) snd))
            (0, snd) :=
          (hflowjoint.comp_continuous
            ((continuous_const.max $ continuous_id.min continuous_const).comp
                continuous_fst |>.prodMk continuous_const)
            λp => ⟨⟨le_max_left .., max_le (lt_trans ht.1 ht.2).le
              ((min_le_right ..).trans ht.2.le)⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩).continuousAt
        simpa only [show u 0 = 0 from (max_eq_right $ le_min le_rfl ht.1.le).trans
          (min_eq_left ht.1.le), hinit, dist_self, zero_mul] using
          (this.dist hj).mul tendsto_const_nhds
      filter_upwards [Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp this δ hδ,
        hd.eventually $ Iio_mem_nhds hδ]
        with p hp1 hp2
      apply hδg
      split_ifs with hps
      exact hp1
      rewrite [not_le] at hps
      have := hminIoo_gen p.1 hps
      rewrite [show u p.1 = min p.1 t from max_eq_right $ le_min hps.le ht.1.le] at hp2
      have hkey := hanti _ this (Ψ (min p.1 t) p.2) snd
      simp only [hΨ_right _ this p.2] at hkey
      exact (hkey.trans $ mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Real.exp_monotone $ mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_right ..)
          NNReal.zero_le_coe) dist_nonneg).trans_lt hp2
      exact (this.comp_continuousOn $ hΨco.comp
        ((continuous_fst.min continuous_const).prodMk continuous_snd).continuousOn

  set a : ℝ := -1/2 with ha

 $ by norm_num

    measurable_fst.mul $ (extremalTest_measurable.comp measurable_snd).mul

      apply MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.of_bound _ hMeas.aestronglyMeasurable
        $ _ * _
      filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem
        (measurableSet_Ioc.prod measurableSet_Ioc)] with p hp
      simp only [Function.uncurry, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      apply mul_le_mul (by rewrite [abs_of_pos hp.1.1]; exact hp.1.2)
        (mul_le_mul (extremalTest_abs_le _) (extremalTest_abs_le _) (abs_nonneg _)
