name: LocalComplexGeometry.holomorphic_constant_rank
proof:
theorem holomorphic_constant_rank
    {n m r : ℕ}
    {F : ComplexEuclidean n → ComplexEuclidean m}
    {a : ComplexEuclidean n}
    (hF : AnalyticAt ℂ F a)
    (hrn : r ≤ n)
    (hrm : r ≤ m)
    (hconst : ∀ᶠ x in nhds a, complexRank (fderiv ℂ F x) = r) :
    ∃ (phi : LocalBiholomorphAt
          (ComplexEuclidean n) (ComplexEuclidean n) a 0)
      (psi : LocalBiholomorphAt
          (ComplexEuclidean m) (ComplexEuclidean m) (F a) 0),
      (fun x ↦ psi.toFun (F (phi.invFun x))) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
        standardRankMap n m r := by set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in set_option smartUnfolding false in set_option backward.isDefEq.lazyWhnfCore false in set_option backward.isDefEq.lazyProjDelta false in unhygienic
  obtain ⟨n', rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hrn
  obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hrm
  let A := fderiv ℂ F a
  let R := LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap
  have hRankR : Module.finrank ℂ R = r := hconst.self_of_nhds
  have h_ := R.exists_isCompl
  have hRQtop := Submodule.IsCompl.isTopCompl_of_isClosed_of_finiteDimensional h_.choose_spec
    R.closed_of_finiteDimensional
  have := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ R
  have := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ h_.choose
  let pR := R.projectionOntoL h_.choose hRQtop
  let targetDecomp := (R.prodEquivOfIsTopCompl h_.choose hRQtop).symm
  let f := pR.toLinearMap.comp A.toLinearMap
  have hgSurj : Function.Surjective ⇑f :=
    rangeProjection_comp_surjective A h_.choose hRQtop
  let K := f.ker
  have := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ K
  rcases K.exists_isCompl
  have hKLtop := Submodule.IsCompl.isTopCompl_of_isClosed_of_finiteDimensional h
    K.closed_of_finiteDimensional
  let kproj := K.projectionOntoL w hKLtop
  let H x := (pR $ F x - F a, kproj $ x - a)
  have hHAnalytic : AnalyticAt ℂ H a :=
    ((pR.analyticAt _).comp $ hF.sub analyticAt_const).prod
      ((kproj.analyticAt _).comp $ analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const)
  let chiRaw := LocalBiholomorphAt.ofAnalyticAtOfFDerivEquiv hHAnalytic
    (f.equivProdOfSurjectiveOfIsCompl kproj.toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hgSurj)
      (Submodule.range_projectionOntoL hKLtop)
      (Submodule.ker_projectionOntoL hKLtop ▸ h)).toContinuousLinearEquiv
    ((pR.hasFDerivAt.comp a
        (hF.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt.sub_const _)).prodMk
      (kproj.hasFDerivAt.comp a $ (hasFDerivAt_id a).sub_const a)).fderiv
  have : H a = (0, 0) := by
    simp only [H, sub_self, ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero]
  let chi : LocalBiholomorphAt _ _ a _ :=
    .mk H chiRaw.invFun this (this ▸ chiRaw.map_target) hHAnalytic (this ▸ chiRaw.analyticAt_invFun) chiRaw.left_inv $ this ▸ chiRaw.right_inv
  let P z := targetDecomp $ F (chi.invFun z) - F a
  have : AnalyticAt ℂ P 0 :=
    (targetDecomp.analyticAt _).comp
      ((hF.comp_of_eq chi.analyticAt_invFun chi.map_target).sub analyticAt_const)
  have hPfst : ∀ᶠ z in nhds 0, (P z).1 = z.1 :=
    chi.right_inv.mono λz hz ↦ congrArg Prod.fst hz
  let q₀ u := (P (u, 0)).2
  let shear := LocalBiholomorphAt.fiberShearAtZero q₀
    (analyticAt_snd.comp
      (this.comp_of_eq (analyticAt_id.prod analyticAt_const) rfl))
 $ by
      simp only [q₀, P, chi.map_target, sub_self, ContinuousLinearEquiv.map_zero]
      rfl
  have hNormal : (λz ↦ ((P z).1, (P z).2 - q₀ (P z).1)) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
      λz ↦ (z.1, 0) := by
    filter_upwards [hPfst, eventually_snd_eq_slice_of_rank this hPfst
      ((eventually_complexLinearRank_affineConjugate
        hF chi targetDecomp hconst P rfl).mono
        λz hz ↦ hz.trans hRankR.symm)] with z h h'
    simp [q₀, h, h']
  have := f.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rewrite [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hgSurj, finrank_top,
    hRankR, Module.finrank_fin_fun] at this
  have eR := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq $ hRankR.trans (Module.finrank_fin_fun ℂ).symm
  have eK := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq
    ((Nat.add_left_cancel this).trans (Module.finrank_fin_fun ℂ).symm)
  have := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq
      ((Nat.add_left_cancel $ by
          simpa only [hRankR, Module.finrank_fin_fun] using
            Submodule.finrank_add_eq_of_isCompl h_.choose_spec).trans
        (Module.finrank_fin_fun ℂ).symm)
  let eSource := (eR.prodCongr eK).trans $ finProdContinuousLinearEquiv r n'
  let eTarget := (eR.prodCongr this).trans $ finProdContinuousLinearEquiv r m'
  refine ⟨chi.trans $ LocalBiholomorphAt.ofContinuousLinearEquivAtZero eSource,
    (LocalBiholomorphAt.affine targetDecomp _ 0).trans
      (shear.trans $ LocalBiholomorphAt.ofContinuousLinearEquivAtZero eTarget),
    (hNormal.comp_tendsto $ eSource.symm.continuous.tendsto' 0 0
      (LinearMap.map_zero _)).mono λx hx ↦ by
    simp only [LocalBiholomorphAt.trans, LocalBiholomorphAt.affine, add_zero]
    apply (congrArg eTarget hx).trans
      (productEquiv_fst_zero_eq_standardRankMap r n' m' eR eK this x)⟩

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PartialTriangulation.exists_chartMatchingControlOn_of_metricSpace
proof:
theorem exists_chartMatchingControlOn_of_metricSpace
    {S' : Type*} [MetricSpace S']
    (T : PartialTriangulation S') (c : MoiseChart S')
    (U : Set T.toIntrinsic.realization) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hsub : U ⊆ T.chartOverlap c) :
    ∃ mu : U → ℝ,
      StronglyPositiveOn Set.univ mu ∧
      ∀ (g' : U → c.kind.modelRegion)
        (g : T.toIntrinsic.realization → S'),
        (∀ y : U, g y.1 = (c.chart.symm (g' y)).1) →
        (∀ y : U,
          dist (g' y : Plane)
            (T.chartOverlapMap c ⟨y.1, hsub y.2⟩) ≤ mu y) →
        MatchesAtFrontier U g T.embed ∧
          Disjoint (g '' U) (T.embed '' Uᶜ) := by set_option smartUnfolding false in unhygienic
  let psi := λz ↦ (c.chart.symm z).1
  by_cases hComp : Uᶜ.Nonempty
  swap
  refine ⟨_, λ_ _ _ ↦ .intro 1 $ .intro one_pos λ_ _ ↦ le_rfl,
    λ_ g _ _ ↦ matchesAtFrontier_and_disjoint_of_compl_not_nonempty T U hU hComp g⟩
  let sS : U → ℝ := λy ↦
    Metric.infDist (T.embed y.1) $ T.embed '' Uᶜ
  let A := λy ↦
    {r | r ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ z,
      dist z (T.chartOverlapModelMap c ⟨y.1, hsub y.2⟩) < r →
        dist (psi z) (T.embed y.1) < sS y}
  have hAbdd y : BddAbove (A y) := .intro 1 λr hr ↦ hr.1
  have hUniform C (hC : IsCompact C) :
      ∃ δ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ C, min δ 1 ∈ A y := by
    have : Continuous (λq : S' × c.kind.modelRegion ↦
        dist (psi q.2) q.1) :=
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp c.chart.symm.continuous).comp
        continuous_snd).dist continuous_fst
    rcases (hC.image $ (T.isEmbedding.continuous.comp
                continuous_subtype_val).prodMk
                ((T.isEmbedding_chartOverlapModelMap c).continuous.comp
                  (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _))).exists_cthickening_subset_open
                (isOpen_lt this
                  ((Metric.continuous_infDist_pt _).comp continuous_fst))
 $ by
                  rintro q ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
                  simpa only [↓Set.mem_setOf_eq, ↓Function.comp_apply,
                    show psi (T.chartOverlapModelMap c _) =
                      T.embed y.1 from
                      congrArg Subtype.val
                        (c.chart.symm_apply_apply $ T.chartOverlapToDomain c $ .mk y.1 _),
                    dist_self] using
                    (IsClosed.notMem_iff_infDist_pos
                      (hU.isClosed_compl.isCompact.image T.isEmbedding.continuous).isClosed
                      (hComp.image T.embed)).mp
 $ by
                        rintro ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
                        rewrite [T.isEmbedding.injective hxy] at hx
                        refine hx y.2
    refine .intro _ $ .intro h.1 λy hyC ↦ ⟨min_le_right .., λz hz ↦
      h.2 $ Metric.mem_cthickening_of_dist_le (T.embed y.1, z) _ w _ ⟨y, hyC, rfl⟩
 $ by simp only [Function.comp_apply, dist_prod_same_left]; apply hz.le.trans $ min_le_left w 1⟩
  refine ⟨λy ↦ sSup (A y) / 2, ?_, ?_⟩
  refine λC hC _ ↦ (hUniform C hC).elim λδ hδ =>
    ⟨_, half_pos $ lt_min hδ.1 one_pos, λy hy ↦
      (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right (b := sSup $ A y) two_pos).mpr
        (le_csSup (hAbdd y) $ hδ.2 y hy)⟩
  intros
  have replacementClose y : dist (g y.1) (T.embed y.1) < sS y := by
    have := hUniform {y} isCompact_singleton
    rcases exists_lt_of_lt_csSup ⟨_, this.choose_spec.2 y rfl⟩
                (half_lt_self $ (lt_min this.choose_spec.1 one_pos).trans_le
                  (le_csSup (hAbdd y) $ this.choose_spec.2 y rfl))
    refine a y ▸ h.1.2 _ (lt_of_le_of_lt (a_1 y) h.2)
  constructor
  intro
  intro
  refine tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mpr
    (squeeze_zero'
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall λ_ ↦ dist_nonneg) ?_
      (((tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mp
        ((T.isEmbedding.continuous.tendsto x).mono_left
          nhdsWithin_le_nhds)).const_mul 2).mono_right
        (le_of_eq $ by rw [mul_zero])))
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y' hy'
  refine (dist_triangle ..).trans
    ((add_le_add ((replacementClose $ .mk y' hy').le.trans
        (Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem
          (Set.mem_image_of_mem T.embed
            (hU.isClosed_compl.frontier_subset $ by rwa [frontier_compl]))))
        le_rfl).trans
      (two_mul _).symm.le)
  rewrite [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro z ⟨x, hxU, rfl⟩ ⟨⟩
  refine lt_irrefl _
    (((Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem
        (Set.mem_image_of_mem T.embed h.1)).trans
      (dist_comm ..).le).trans_lt
      (h.2.symm ▸ replacementClose ⟨x, hxU⟩))

proof:
theorem insertZero_nonadjacent_disjoint (J : PolygonalCircle) {p : Plane}
    (hp : p ∈ J.edgeSegment 0) (hp0 : p ≠ J.vertex 0) (hp1 : p ≠ J.vertex 1)
    (i j : ZMod (J.n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (hprev : i ≠ j + 1)
    (hnext : j ≠ i + 1) :
    J.insertZeroEdgeSegment p i ∩ J.insertZeroEdgeSegment p j = ∅ := by set_option backward.isDefEq.lazyWhnfCore false in set_option smartUnfolding false in
  unhygienic
  have hF : Fact (1 < J.n) := ⟨Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide) J.three_le⟩
  rewrite [← i.natCast_zmod_val, ← j.natCast_zmod_val] at hij hprev hnext ⊢
  have hwrap := ZMod.natCast_self' J.n
  have := Nat.zero_lt_one.trans hF.out
  have hf := J.disjoint_insertZero_first_previous hp hp0 hp1
  have hg := J.disjoint_insertZero_last_next hp hp0 hp1
  have hd0 : ∀ k < J.n, 0 < k → k ≠ 1 → k ≠ J.n - 1 →
      Disjoint (J.edgeSegment 0) (J.edgeSegment ↑k) := by
    intros
    rewrite [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
    apply J.nonadjacent_disjoint <;> intro h <;> rewrite [← Nat.cast_zero] at h
    refine a_1.ne' (natCast_eq_natCast_of_lt this a h).symm
    refine k.succ_ne_zero
      (natCast_eq_natCast_of_lt (by omega) this
        (k.cast_add_one.trans h.symm))
    apply a_2
    rw [natCast_eq_succ_of_pos_lt a_1 a this h]
  rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp i.val_lt with hmlt | hmn
    <;> rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp j.val_lt with hllt | hln
  rcases i.val.eq_zero_or_pos with hm0 | hm0
  cases j.val.eq_zero_or_pos
  refine absurd (congrArg _ $ hm0.trans h.symm) hij
  simp only [hm0, Nat.cast_zero, J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_zero,
    J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_middle p h hllt]
  by_cases hl1 : j.val = 1
  refine nomatch hnext $ by rewrite [hl1, hm0]; norm_num
  by_cases hllast : j.val = J.n - 1
  refine hllast ▸ hf.inter_eq
  refine (hd0 j.val hllt h hl1 hllast).mono_left
    (J.insertZero_first_subset_edge_zero hp) |>.inter_eq
  rewrite [J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_middle p hm0 hmlt]
  rcases j.val.eq_zero_or_pos with hl0 | hl0
  simp only [hl0, Nat.cast_zero, J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_zero]
  by_cases hm1 : i.val = 1
  refine nomatch hprev $ by rewrite [hm1, hl0]; norm_num
  by_cases hmlast : i.val = J.n - 1
  refine hmlast.symm ▸ hf.symm.inter_eq
  refine (hd0 i.val hmlt hm0 hm1 hmlast).symm.mono_right
    (J.insertZero_first_subset_edge_zero hp) |>.inter_eq
  rewrite [J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_middle p hl0 hllt]
  apply J.nonadjacent_disjoint <;> intro h
  apply hij
  rw [natCast_eq_natCast_of_lt hmlt hllt h]
  apply hprev
  rw [natCast_eq_succ_of_pos_lt hm0 hmlt hllt h, Nat.cast_add_one]
  apply hnext
  rw [natCast_eq_succ_of_pos_lt hl0 hllt hmlt h, Nat.cast_add_one]
  cases i.val.eq_zero_or_pos
  rewrite [hln, h] at hprev
  refine absurd hwrap.symm hprev
  rewrite [J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_middle p h hmlt, hln,
    J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_last]
  by_cases hm1 : i.val = 1
  rewrite [hm1, Nat.cast_one]
  refine hg.symm.inter_eq
  by_cases hmlast : i.val = J.n - 1
  refine (hnext $ by
    rw [hln, hmlast, ← Nat.cast_add_one, Nat.sub_add_cancel hF.out.le]).elim
  refine (hd0 i.val hmlt h hm1 hmlast).symm.mono_right
    (J.insertZero_last_subset_edge_zero hp) |>.inter_eq
  rcases j.val.eq_zero_or_pos
  rewrite [h, hmn] at hnext
  refine absurd hwrap.symm hnext
  rewrite [hmn, J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_last,
    J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_middle p h hllt]
  by_cases hl1 : j.val = 1
  rewrite [hl1, Nat.cast_one]
  refine hg.inter_eq
  by_cases hllast : j.val = J.n - 1
  refine (hprev $ by
    rw [hmn, hllast, ← Nat.cast_add_one, Nat.sub_add_cancel hF.out.le]).elim
  refine (hd0 j.val hllt h hl1 hllast).mono_left
    (J.insertZero_last_subset_edge_zero hp) |>.inter_eq

name: RS.cechCount
proof:
theorem cechCount : Module.finrank ℂ (RS.Cech.H1 (0 : RS.Divisor X)) ≤ genus X := by unhygienic
  classical
  by_contra!
  let g : ℤ := genus X
  let h0 := RS.Finiteness.h1 (0 : RS.Divisor X)
  have : g < h0 := Nat.cast_lt.mpr this
  have := Classical.arbitrary X
  let D₀ := Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single this $ 2 * g
  let B := Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single this $ g + h0 + 1
  let E := Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single this $ 3 * g + h0 + 1
  have hbound (q : RS.LinSys B) : RS.Cech.MulBound _ D₀ E :=
    RS.Cech.mulBound_of_mem_linSys q.2 λx => by
      simp only [D₀, E, B, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply]
      split_ifs <;> omega
  have hhE : RS.Finiteness.h1 E = h0 - g :=
    h1_single_eq this $ by omega
  have hhD₀ : RS.Finiteness.h1 D₀ = h0 - g :=
    h1_single_eq this $ by omega
  have : (RS.l B : ℤ) = h0 + 2 :=
    (l_single_eq this $ by omega).trans $ by ring
  haveI := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos
    (by omega : 0 < RS.Finiteness.h1 D₀)
  rcases exists_ne (0 : RS.Cech.H1 D₀)
  let Φ : RS.LinSys B →ₗ[ℂ] RS.Cech.H1 E :=
    { toFun := λq => RS.Cech.mulH1 _ (hbound q) w
      map_add' := λq r =>
        RS.Cech.mulH1_add _ _ _ w
      map_smul' := λa q =>
        RS.Cech.mulH1_smul a _ _ w }
  rcases Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot
    (Φ.ker_ne_bot_of_finrank_lt (by omega : RS.Finiteness.h1 E < RS.l B))
  apply h
    ((LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank
      (mod_cast hhD₀.trans hhE.symm)).mpr
      (RS.Cech.mulH1_surjective (h_1.2 $ Subtype.ext ·) $ hbound w_1)
      (h_1.1.trans (LinearMap.map_zero _).symm))

(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)

    (t := Set.univ.pi λ_ => Set.Icc B T)

    induction k

    apply a 1

    apply this _ _ (Nat.le_add_left 4 _) (Nat.le_add_left 4 _)
